        # Update target based on role and situation
        if nearest_enemy and min_distance < 300:
            self.target = nearest_enemy
            self.ai_state = "combat"
        else:
            self.target = None
            if self.role == RobotRole.SCAT:
                self.ai_state = "scout"
            elif self.role == RobotRole.DEFENDER:        else:
            self.target = None
            if self.role == RobotRole.Scout:
                self.ai_state = "scout"
            elif self.role == RobotRole.DEFENDER:                self.ai_state = "defend"
            elif self.role == RobotRole.SUPPORT:
                self.ai_state = "support"
            else:
                self.ai_state = "patrol"
        
        # Execute behavior based on AI state
        if self.ai_state == "combat" and self.target and self.weapon:
            # Use weapon if available and in range
            if self.position.distance_to(self.target.position) <= self.weapon.range:
                if self.cooldown <= 0:
                    # Fire weapon
                    self.weapon.fire(self, self.target, environment)
                    self.cooldown = self.weapon.cooldown
            else:
                # Move toward enemy
                direction = (self.target.position - self.position).normalize()
                self.velocity = direction * 150
                
        elif self.ai_state == "patrol":
            # Patrol between waypoints
            if not hasattr(self, 'patrol_waypoints'):
                self.patrol_waypoints = [
                    Vector2D(random.randint(100, SCREEN_WIDTH - 100), random.randint(100, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 100))
                    for _ in range(3)
                ]
                self.current_waypoint = 0
            
            target = self.patrol_waypoints[self.current_waypoint]
            direction = (target - self.position).normalize()
            distance = self.position.distance_to(target)
            
            if distance < 30:
                self.current_waypoint = (self.current_waypoint + 1) % len(self.patrol_waypoints)
            
            self.velocity = direction * 80
            
        elif self.ai_state == "defend":
            # Defend base
            base_pos = environment.team_bases[self.team]
            direction = (base_pos - self.position).normalize()
            self.velocity = direction * 50
            
            # If enemy nearby, engage
            if nearest_enemy and min_distance < 200:
                self.target = nearest_enemy
                self.ai_state = "combat"
        
        elif self.ai_state == "support":
            # Support teammates
            teammate = self.find_nearest_teammate(environment)
            if teammate and teammate.health < teammate.max_health * 0.5:
                direction = (teammate.position - self.position).normalize()
                self.velocity = direction * 70
                # Use support ability
                if self.weapon and self.weapon.type == WeaponType.SUPPORT and self.cooldown <= 0:
                    self.weapon.fire(self, teammate, environment)
                    self.cooldown = self.weapon.cooldown
            else:
                # Default patrol near base
                base_pos = environment.team_bases[self.team]
                direction = (base_pos - self.position).normalize()
                self.velocity = direction * 60
                
        elif self.ai_state == "scout":
            # Scout the map
            if not hasattr(self, 'scout_waypoints'):
                self.scout_waypoints = [
                    Vector2D(random.randint(100, SCREEN_WIDTH - 100), random.randint(100, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 100))
                    for _ in range(5)
                ]
                self.current_scout_point = 0
            
            target = self.scout_waypoints[self.current_scout_point]
            direction = (target - self.position).normalize()
            distance = self.position.distance_to(target)
            
            if distance < 50:
                self.current_scout_point = (self.current_scout_point + 1) % len(self.scout_waypoints)
            
            self.velocity = direction * 120
            
        # Handle objectives
        if environment.objective_type == ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE:
            flag_pos = environment.flag_position
            if self.position.distance_to(flag_pos) < 80 and not environment.flag_captured_by:
                # Capture flag
                environment.flag_captured_by = self.team
                self.objective_progress = 1.0
            elif environment.flag_captured_by == self.team:
                # Return flag to base
                base_pos = environment.team_bases[self.team]
                direction = (base_pos - self.position).normalize()
                self.velocity = direction * 60
                
        # Learn from experience
        if self.strategy_memory and len(self.strategy_memory) > 10:
            self.adapt_strategy(environment)
    
    def find_nearest_teammate(self, environment: 'Environment') -> Optional['Robot']:
        nearest = None
        min_distance = float('inf')
        
        for robot in environment.robots:
            if robot.team == self.team and robot.is_alive and robot != self:
                distance = self.position.distance_to(robot.position)
                if distance < min_distance:
                    min_distance = distance
                    nearest = robot
        
        return nearest
    
    def adapt_strategy(self, environment: 'Environment'):
        # Analyze past performance and adjust behavior
        # Simple example: increase aggression if winning, become defensive if losing
        team_score = environment.team_scores[self.team]
        enemy_score = environment.team_scores[1 - self.team]
        
        if team_score > enemy_score:
            # We're winning, become more aggressive
            if self.role == RobotRole.DEFENDER:
                self.role = RobotRole.ATTACKER
        else:
            # We're losing, become more defensive
            if self.role == RobotRole.ATTACKER:
                self.role = RobotRole.DEFENDER
        
        # Adjust strategy based on success rate
        recent_success = sum(1 for m in self.strategy_memory[-5:] if m.get('success', False))
        if recent_success > 3:
            # Good performance, try more complex tactics
            self.ai_state = "complex_attack"
        elif recent_success < 2:
            # Poor performance, simplify tactics
            self.ai_state = "patrol"

@dataclass
class Weapon:
    type: WeaponType
    name: str
    damage: float
    range: float
    ammo: int
    max_ammo: int
    cooldown: float
    projectile_speed: float = 500.0
    fire_sound: str = "pew"
    
    def fire(self, shooter: Robot, target: Robot, environment: 'Environment'):
        if self.ammo <= 0:
            return
            
        self.ammo -= 1
        
        # Create projectile based on weapon type
        if self.type == WeaponType.RANGED:
            # Calculate direction to target
            direction = (target.position - shooter.position).normalize()
            projectile = Projectile(
                shooter.position.copy(), 
                direction * self.projectile_speed, 
                self.damage, 
                shooter.team, 
                projectile_type=self.type
            )
            environment.projectiles.append(projectile)
            
        elif self.type == WeaponType.MELEE:
            # Melee attack - check for targets in range
            for robot in environment.robots:
                if robot.team != shooter.team and robot.is_alive:
                    if shooter.position.distance_to(robot.position) < 80:
                        robot.take_damage(self.damage)
                        # Add visual effect
                        environment.particles.append(Particle(
                            robot.position.x, robot.position.y, COLOR_RED, 10
                        ))
                        
        elif self.type == WeaponType.EXPLOSIVE:
            # Explosive attack - create area effect
            explosion = Explosion(
                shooter.position.copy(), 
                self.damage, 
                100, 
                shooter.team
            )
            environment.explosions.append(explosion)
            
        elif self.type == WeaponType.SUPPORT:
            # Support ability - heal or shield teammate
            if target and target.team == shooter.team and target.is_alive:
                target.heal(self.damage)
                # Add visual effect
                environment.particles.append(Particle(
                    target.position.x, target.position.y, COLOR_GREEN, 15
                ))
        
        # Play sound effect (simulated)
        environment.play_sound(self.fire_sound)

@dataclass
class Projectile:
    position: Vector2D
    velocity: Vector2D
    damage: float
    team: int
    lifetime: float = 3.0
    projectile_type: WeaponType = WeaponType.RANGED
    radius: float = 5.0
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        self.position += self.velocity * delta_time
        self.lifetime -= delta_time
        return self.lifetime > 0

@dataclass
class Explosion:
    position: Vector2D
    damage: float
    radius: float
    team: int
    lifetime: float = 1.5
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float, environment: 'Environment'):
        self.lifetime -= delta_time
        
        # Apply damage to nearby robots
        for robot in environment.robots:
            if robot.is_alive and robot.team != self.team:
                distance = self.position.distance_to(robot.position)
                if distance < self.radius:
                    # Damage decreases with distance
                    damage_factor = 1 - (distance / self.radius)
                    robot.take_damage(self.damage * damage_factor)
                    # Add particle effect
                    environment.particles.append(Particle(
                        robot.position.x, robot.position.y, COLOR_ORANGE, 8
                    ))
        
        return self.lifetime > 0

@dataclass
class Particle:
    x: float
    y: float
    color: Tuple[int, int, int]
    lifetime: float
    velocity: Vector2D = field(default_factory=lambda: Vector2D(
        random.uniform(-50, 50), 
        random.uniform(-50, 50)
    ))
    size: float = 3.0
    decay_rate: float = 0.05
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float) -> bool:
        self.x += self.velocity.x * delta_time
        self.y += self.velocity.y * delta_time
        self.lifetime -= delta_time
        self.size -= self.decay_rate * delta_time
        return self.lifetime > 0 and self.size > 0

class PowerUp:

@dataclass
class Environment:
    robots: List[Robot] = field(default_factory=list)
    projectiles: List[Projectile] = field(default_factory=list)
    explosions: List[Explosion] = field(default_factory=list)
    particles: List[Particle] = field(default_factory=list)
    powerups: List[PowerUp] = field(default_factory=list)
    hazards: List[Hazard] = field(default_factory=list)
    team_bases: Dict[int, Vector2D] = field(default_factory=dict)
    flag_position: Vector2D = field(default_factory=lambda: Vector2D(SCREEN_WIDTH // 2, SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2))
    flag_captured_by: Optional[int] = None
    objective_type: ObjectiveType = ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE
    team_scores: Dict[int, float] = field(default_factory=lambda: {0: 0, 1: 0})
    round_time: float = 0.0
    last_powerup_spawn: float = 0
    last_hazard_spawn: float = 0
    difficulty_level: float = 1.0
    ai_adaptation_cooldown: float = 0
    sound_queue: queue.Queue = field(default_factory=queue.Queue)
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        # Initialize team bases
        self.team_bases[0] = Vector2D(100, SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2)
        self.team_bases[1] = Vector2D(SCREEN_WIDTH - 100, SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2)
        
        # Spawn initial power-ups
        self.spawn_powerups(3)
        
        # Spawn initial hazards
        self.spawn_hazards(2)
    
    def spawn_powerups(self, count: int):
        for _ in range(count):
            x = random.randint(100, SCREEN_WIDTH - 100)
            y = random.randint(100, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 100)
            powerup_type = random.choice(list(PowerUpType))
            self.powerups.append(PowerUp(Vector2D(x, y), powerup_type))
    
    def spawn_hazards(self, count: int):
        for _ in range(count):
            x = random.randint(100, SCREEN_WIDTH - 100)
            y = random.randint(100, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 100)
            hazard_type = random.choice(list(HazardType))
            radius = random.randint(50, 120)
            damage = random.uniform(5, 15)
            self.hazards.append(Hazard(Vector2D(x, y), hazard_type, radius, damage))
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        self.round_time += delta_time
        
        # Update projectiles
        self.projectiles = [p for p in self.projectiles if p.update(delta_time)]
        
        # Update explosions
        self.explosions = [e for e in self.explosions if e.update(delta_time, self)]
        
        # Update particles
        self.particles = [p for p in self.particles if p.update(delta_time)]
        
        # Update power-ups
        self.powerups = [p for p in self.powerups if p.update(delta_time)]
        
        # Update hazards
        self.hazards = [h for h in self.hazards if h.update(delta_time)]
        
        # Spawn new power-ups if needed
        if time.time() - self.last_powerup_spawn > 20:
            self.spawn_powerups(1)
            self.last_powerup_spawn = time.time()
        
        # Spawn new hazards if needed
        if time.time() - self.last_hazard_spawn > 30:
            self.spawn_hazards(1)
            self.last_hazard_spawn = time.time()
        
        # Update AI difficulty based on performance
        if self.ai_adaptation_cooldown <= 0:
            self.adapt_difficulty()
            self.ai_adaptation_cooldown = 10.0  # Cooldown before next adaptation
        
        self.ai_adaptation_cooldown -= delta_time
        
        # Check for objective completion
        self.check_objective_completion()
    
    def adapt_difficulty(self):
        # Calculate average team performance
        team_0_avg = sum(1 for r in self.robots if r.team == 0 and r.is_alive) / ROBOTS_PER_TEAM
        team_1_avg = sum(1 for r in self.robots if r.team == 1 and r.is_alive) / ROBOTS_PER_TEAM
        
        # Adjust difficulty based on team performance
        if team_0_avg > team_1_avg:
            # Team 0 is doing better - make Team 1 slightly stronger
            self.difficulty_level = min(2.0, self.difficulty_level + 0.1)
        elif team_1_avg > team_0_avg:
            # Team 1 is doing better - make Team 0 slightly stronger
            self.difficulty_level = min(2.0, self.difficulty_level + 0.1)
        else:
            # Teams are balanced - reset difficulty slightly
            self.difficulty_level = max(0.5, self.difficulty_level - 0.05)
        
        # Adjust AI behavior based on difficulty
        for robot in self.robots:
            if robot.team == 0:  # Adjust AI for team 0
                robot.max_health = 100 + (self.difficulty_level - 1.0) * 50
                robot.max_energy = 100 + (self.difficulty_level - 1.0) * 30
                robot.armor = 0 + (self.difficulty_level - 1.0) * 40
            else:  # Adjust AI for team 1
                robot.max_health = 100 + (self.difficulty_level - 1.0) * 50
                robot.max_energy = 100 + (self.difficulty_level - 1.0) * 30
                robot.armor = 0 + (self.difficulty_level - 1.0) * 40
    
    def check_objective_completion(self):
        if self.objective_type == ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE:
            if self.flag_captured_by is not None:
                # Flag has been captured
                if self.round_time > 5:  # Must hold flag for 5 seconds
                    self.team_scores[self.flag_captured_by] += 10
                    self.objective_type = ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE  # Reset
                    self.flag_captured_by = None
                    self.flag_position = Vector2D(
                        random.randint(100, SCREEN_WIDTH - 100), 
                        random.randint(100, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 100)
                    )
                    
        elif self.objective_type == ObjectiveType.ELIMINATION:
            team0_alive = sum(1 for r in self.robots if r.team == 0 and r.is_alive)
            team1_alive = sum(1 for r in self.robots if r.team == 1 and r.is_alive)
            
            if team0_alive == 0:
                self.team_scores[1] += 20
                self.objective_type = ObjectiveType.ELIMINATION
            elif team1_alive == 0:
                self.team_scores[0] += 20
                self.objective_type = ObjectiveType.ELIMINATION
    
    def play_sound(self, sound_name: str):
        # In a real implementation, this would play an audio file
        # Here we simulate sound with a queue for potential audio system integration
        self.sound_queue.put(sound_name)

class CyberArena:
    def __init__(self):
        pygame.init()
        self.screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
        pygame.display.set_caption("CyberArena - Futuristic Robot Battle Arena")
        self.clock = pygame.time.Clock()
        
        # Initialize environment
        self.environment = Environment()
        
        # Initialize robots
        self.init_robots()
        
        # Game state
        self.running = True
        self.paused = False
        self.game_over = False
        self.winner = None
        self.font = pygame.font.SysFont('Arial', 18)
        self.small_font = pygame.font.SysFont('Arial', 14)
        
        # Debug mode
        self.show_debug = False
        
        # Audio system (simulated)
        self.sound_effects = {
            "pew": "pew sound",
            "boom": "explosion sound",
            "powerup": "powerup sound",
            "damage": "damage sound"
        }
        
        # Initialize visual effects
        self.lighting_effects = []
    
    def init_robots(self):
        # Create robots for each team
        for team in range(TEAM_COUNT):
            for i in range(ROBOTS_PER_TEAM):
                # Assign roles based on index
                role_map = [RobotRole.ATTACKER, RobotRole.DEFENDER, RobotRole.SUPPORT, RobotRole.SCAT]
                role = role_map[i]
                
                # Position robots around their base
                base = self.environment.team_bases[team]
                angle = (i * 2 * math.pi) / ROBOTS_PER_TEAM
                offset_x = 50 * math.cos(angle)
                offset_y = 50 * math.sin(angle)
                
                position = Vector2D(base.x + offset_x, base.y + offset_y)
                
                # Create weapon for robot
                weapon_type = WeaponType.RANGED
                if role == RobotRole.MELEE:
                    weapon_type = WeaponType.MELEE
                elif role == RobotRole.SUPPORT:
                    weapon_type = WeaponType.SUPPORT
                
                weapon = Weapon(
                    type=weapon_type,
                    name=f"{role.value.title()} Weapon",
                    damage=20 + random.randint(0, 10),
                    range=300,
                    ammo=100,
                    max_ammo=100,
                    cooldown=1.0,
                    projectile_speed=500
                )
                
                robot = Robot(
                    id=len(self.environment.robots),
                    team=team,
                    role=role,
                    position=position,
                    weapon=weapon,
                    health=100,
                    max_health=100,
                    armor=0,
                    energy=100,
                    max_energy=100,
                    cooldown=0,
                    strategy_memory=[],
                    ai_state="patrol"
                )
                
                self.environment.robots.append(robot)
    
    def handle_events(self):
        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                self.running = False
            elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key == pygame.K_p:
                    self.paused = not self.paused
                elif event.key == pygame.K_d:
                    self.show_debug = not self.show_debug
                elif event.key == pygame.K_r:
                    self.reset_game()
                elif event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
                    self.running = False
    
    def reset_game(self):
        self.environment = Environment()
        self.init_robots()
        self.game_over = False
        self.winner = None
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        if self.paused or self.game_over:
            return
        
        # Update environment
        self.environment.update(delta_time)
        
        # Update robots
        for robot in self.environment.robots:
            if robot.is_alive:
                robot.update(delta_time, self.environment)
        
        # Check for collisions between projectiles and robots
        for projectile in self.environment.projectiles[:]:
            for robot in self.environment.robots:
                if robot.is_alive and robot.team != projectile.team:
                    distance = robot.position.distance_to(projectile.position)
                    if distance < 20:  # Collision radius
                        robot.take_damage(projectile.damage)
                        # Add particle effect
                        self.environment.particles.append(Particle(
                            robot.position.x, robot.position.y, COLOR_RED, 10
                        ))
                        # Remove projectile
                        self.environment.projectiles.remove(projectile)
                        break
        
        # Check for power-up collection
        for robot in self.environment.robots:
            if robot.is_alive:
                for powerup in self.environment.powerups[:]:
                    if robot.position.distance_to(powerup.position) < 40:
                        robot.use_powerup(powerup.type)
                        self.environment.powerups.remove(powerup)
                        self.environment.play_sound("powerup")
                        break
        
        # Check for team elimination
        team0_alive = sum(1 for r in self.environment.robots if r.team == 0 and r.is_alive)
        team1_alive = sum(1 for r in self.environment.robots if r.team == 1 and r.is_alive)
        
        if team0_alive == 0 and team1_alive > 0:
            self.game_over = True
            self.winner = 1
        elif team1_alive == 0 and team0_alive > 0:
            self.game_over = True
            self.winner = 0
    
    def render(self):
        # Clear screen with dark background
        self.screen.fill(COLOR_BLACK)
        
        # Render team bases
        for team, base_pos in self.environment.team_bases.items():
            color = COLOR_RED if team == 0 else COLOR_BLUE
            pygame.draw.circle(self.screen, color, (int(base_pos.x), int(base_pos.y)), 30)
            pygame.draw.circle(self.screen, (255, 255, 255), (int(base_pos.x), int(base_pos.y)), 35, 2)
            
            # Draw team name
            team_text = self.font.render(f"Team {team+1}", True, color)
            self.screen.blit(team_text, (int(base_pos.x - 20), int(base_pos.y + 40)))
        
        # Render flag
        if self.environment.objective_type == ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE:
            flag_color = COLOR_YELLOW if self.environment.flag_captured_by is None else \
                        COLOR_RED if self.environment.flag_captured_by == 0 else COLOR_BLUE
            pygame.draw.circle(self.screen, flag_color, (int(self.environment.flag_position.x), int(self.environment.flag_position.y)), 15)
            pygame.draw.circle(self.screen, COLOR_WHITE, (int(self.environment.flag_position.x), int(self.environment.flag_position.y)), 20, 2)
            
            # Flag capture indicator
            if self.environment.flag_captured_by is not None:
                flag_text = self.font.render(f"Flag Held by Team {self.environment.flag_captured_by + 1}", True, COLOR_WHITE)
                self.screen.blit(flag_text, (SCREEN_WIDTH // 2 - 100, 50))
        
        # Render hazards
        for hazard in self.environment.hazards:
            pygame.draw.circle(self.screen, hazard.color, (int(hazard.position.x), int(hazard.position.y)), int(hazard.radius))
            pygame.draw.circle(self.screen, COLOR_WHITE, (int(hazard.position.x), int(hazard.position.y)), int(hazard.radius), 2)
            
            # Add visual effect
            if hazard.type == HazardType.ELECTRIC_FLOOR:
                for i in range(5):
                    offset_x = random.randint(-5, 5)
                    offset_y = random.randint(-5, 5)
                    pygame.draw.circle(self.screen, (100, 100, 255), 
                                     (int(hazard.position.x + offset_x), int(hazard.position.y + offset_y)), 3)

  "solution.py": "import random
import time
import math
import threading
import queue
from enum import Enum
from typing import List, Dict, Tuple, Optional, Set, Any, Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from collections import defaultdict, deque
import pygame
import numpy as np

# =============================
# CONFIGURATION AND CONSTANTS
# =============================

# Game settings
SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT = 1200, 800
FPS = 60

# Colors
COLOR_BLACK = (0, 0, 0)
COLOR_WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
COLOR_RED = (255, 50, 50)
COLOR_BLUE = (50, 50, 255)
COLOR_GREEN = (50, 255, 50)
COLOR_YELLOW = (255, 255, 50)
COLOR_ORANGE = (255, 165, 0)
COLOR_GRAY = (128, 128, 128)
COLOR_LIGHT_BLUE = (173, 216, 230)

# UI Constants
BUTTON_HEIGHT = 40
PADDING = 10
FONT_SIZE = 18

# =============================
# DATA MODELS
# =============================

class GameType(Enum):
    CHESS_TEAM = "Chess Team"
    DICE_TEAM = "Dice Team"
    CARD_TEAM = "Card Team"
    CUSTOM = "Custom"

@dataclass
class Player:
    name: str
    id: str
    role: str = "Player"
    score: float = 0.0
    performance_history: List[float] = field(default_factory=list)

@dataclass
class Team:
    name: str
    id: str
    players: List[Player] = field(default_factory=list)
    score: float = 0.0
    turn_order: int = 0
    strategy_history: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    color: Tuple[int, int, int] = COLOR_WHITE

    def add_player(self, player: Player):
        self.players.append(player)

    def remove_player(self, player_id: str):
        self.players = [p for p in self.players if p.id != player_id]

    def update_score(self, points: float):
        self.score += points
        self.performance_history.append(self.score)

    def get_avg_performance(self) -> float:
        return np.mean(self.performance_history) if self.performance_history else 0.0

@dataclass
class GameSettings:
    game_type: GameType
    num_teams: int = 2
    max_players_per_team: int = 4
    scoring_rules: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    turn_order_rule: str = "round_robin"  # round_robin, performance_based, custom
    custom_rules: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def validate(self) -> bool:
        if self.num_teams < 2:
            return False
        if self.max_players_per_team < 1:
            return False
        return True

@dataclass
class TeamPerformanceAnalysis:
    team_id: str
    avg_score: float
    score_trend: float  # slope of performance over time
    role_diversity_score: float
    consistency: float  # standard deviation of scores
    recommended_adjustments: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

# =============================
# MACHINE LEARNING COMPONENT
# =============================

class PerformanceAnalyzer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.team_data = defaultdict(list)
        self.model_trained = False
        self.strategy_recommendations = {
            "low_consistency": "Balance player roles to reduce variability in performance.",
            "high_trend_up": "Maintain current strategy; team is improving.",
            "high_trend_down": "Reevaluate team composition or roles; performance is declining.",
            "low_avg_score": "Consider pairing with higher-performing players or adjusting scoring roles.",
            "role_imbalance": "Rotate roles to ensure equitable contribution and skill development."
        }

    def add_team_data(self, team: Team):
        self.team_data[team.id].append({
            'score': team.score,
            'player_roles': [p.role for p in team.players],
            'num_players': len(team.players),
            'timestamp': time.time()
        })

    def analyze_team(self, team: Team) -> TeamPerformanceAnalysis:
        if team.id not in self.team_data or len(self.team_data[team.id]) < 2:
            return TeamPerformanceAnalysis(team_id=team.id, avg_score=team.score, score_trend=0.0, role_diversity_score=1.0, consistency=0.0, recommended_adjustments=[])

        data_points = self.team_data[team.id]
        scores = [dp['score'] for dp in data_points]
        roles = [dp['player_roles'] for dp in data_points]

        avg_score = np.mean(scores)
        score_trend = np.polyfit(range(len(scores)), scores, 1)[0] if len(scores) > 1 else 0.0
        consistency = np.std(scores) if len(scores) > 1 else 0.0

        # Role diversity: measure how many unique roles are used
        unique_roles = set()
        for r_list in roles:
            unique_roles.update(r_list)
        role_diversity_score = len(unique_roles) / 5.0 if len(unique_roles) > 0 else 0.0  # Max 5 roles assumed

        adjustments = []
        if consistency > 15.0:  # High variability
            adjustments.append(self.strategy_recommendations["low_consistency"])
        if score_trend > 2.0:
            adjustments.append(self.strategy_recommendations["high_trend_up"])
        elif score_trend < -2.0:
            adjustments.append(self.strategy_recommendations["high_trend_down"])
        if avg_score < 50.0:
            adjustments.append(self.strategy_recommendations["low_avg_score"])
        if len(unique_roles) < 2:
            adjustments.append(self.strategy_recommendations["role_imbalance"])

        return TeamPerformanceAnalysis(
            team_id=team.id,
            avg_score=avg_score,
            score_trend=score_trend,
            role_diversity_score=role_diversity_score,
            consistency=consistency,
            recommended_adjustments=adjustments
        )

# =============================
# MAIN APPLICATION
# =============================

class BoardGameTeamCollaborator:
    def __init__(self):

@dataclass
class Vector2D:
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def __truediv__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x / scalar, self.y / scalar)
    
    def magnitude(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        mag = self.magnitude()
        if mag == 0:
            return Vector2D(0, 0)
        return Vector2D(self.x / mag, self.y / mag)
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).magnitude()
    
    def copy(self):

@dataclass
class Vector2D:
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def __truediv__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x / scalar, self.y / scalar)
    
    def magnitude(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        mag = self.magnitude()
        if mag == 0:
            return Vector2D(0, 0)
        return Vector2D(self.x / mag, self.y / mag)
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).magnitude()
    
    def copy(self):
        return Vector2D(self.x, self.y)

@dataclass
class Robot:
    id: int
    team: int  # 0 or 1
    role: RobotRole
    position: Vector2D
    velocity: Vector2D = field(default_factory=lambda: Vector2D(0, 0))
    health: float = 100.0
    max_health: float = 100.0
    armor: float = 0.0
    weapon: Optional['Weapon'] = None
    energy: float = 100.0
    max_energy: float = 100.0
    cooldown: float = 0.0
    is_alive: bool = True
    last_seen_enemy: Optional[Vector2D] = None
    objective_progress: float = 0.0
    team_work_score: float = 0.0
    strategy_memory: List[Dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    ai_state: str = "patrol"
    target: Optional['Robot'] = None
    last_action_time: float = 0.0
    inventory: Dict[PowerUpType, int] = field(default_factory=lambda: defaultdict(int))
    control_scheme: str = "default"
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float, environment: 'Environment'):
        # Update cooldown
        if self.cooldown > 0:
            self.cooldown -= delta_time
            self.cooldown = max(0, self.cooldown)
        
        # Update energy regeneration
        self.energy = min(self.max_energy, self.energy + delta_time * 10)
        
        # Update position based on velocity
        self.position += self.velocity * delta_time
        
        # Boundary check
        self.position.x = max(10, min(SCREEN_WIDTH - 10, self.position.x))
        self.position.y = max(10, min(SCREEN_HEIGHT - 10, self.position.y))
        
        # Apply environmental effects
        self.apply_environmental_effects(environment)
        
        # Update AI behavior
        self.ai_behavior(environment)
    
    def apply_environmental_effects(self, environment: 'Environment'):
        # Check for hazard effects
        for hazard in environment.hazards:
            if hazard.type in [HazardType.ELECTRIC_FLOOR, HazardType.FIRE_ZONE]:
                distance = self.position.distance_to(hazard.position)
                if distance < hazard.radius:
                    damage = hazard.damage * (1 - distance / hazard.radius)
                    self.take_damage(damage)
                    
        # Apply slow effects from gravity wells
        for hazard in environment.hazards:
            if hazard.type == HazardType.GRAVITY_WELL:
                distance = self.position.distance_to(hazard.position)
                if distance < hazard.radius:
                    slowdown_factor = 1 - (distance / hazard.radius)
                    self.velocity *= (0.5 + slowdown_factor * 0.5)
    
    def take_damage(self, damage: float):
        # Apply armor reduction first
        armor_reduction = min(self.armor, damage)
        self.armor -= armor_reduction
        damage -= armor_reduction
        
        # Apply remaining damage to health
        if damage > 0:
            self.health -= damage
            if self.health <= 0:
                self.health = 0
                self.is_alive = False
    
    def heal(self, amount: float):
        self.health = min(self.max_health, self.health + amount)
    
    def use_powerup(self, powerup_type: PowerUpType) -> bool:
        if self.inventory[powerup_type] > 0:
            self.inventory[powerup_type] -= 1
            
            if powerup_type == PowerUpType.HEALTH_PACK:
                self.heal(30)
            elif powerup_type == PowerUpType.AMMO_PACK:
                if self.weapon:
                    self.weapon.ammo = min(self.weapon.max_ammo, self.weapon.ammo + 20)
            elif powerup_type == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:
                self.velocity *= 1.5
                threading.Timer(3.0, self.reset_speed).start()
            elif powerup_type == PowerUpType.SHIELD:
                self.armor += 50
                threading.Timer(5.0, self.reset_armor).start()
            elif powerup_type == PowerUpType.TELEPORT:
                # Teleport to random safe location
                safe_pos = self.find_safe_teleport_position()
                if safe_pos:
                    self.position = safe_pos
            elif powerup_type == PowerUpType.SNIPER_FOCUS:
                self.weapon = Weapon(WeaponType.RANGED, "Sniper Rifle", damage=50, range=500, ammo=1, cooldown=5)
            
            return True
        return False
    
    def reset_speed(self):
        self.velocity *= 0.67  # Return to normal speed
    
    def reset_armor(self):
        self.armor = 0
    
    def find_safe_teleport_position(self) -> Optional[Vector2D]:
        # Find a random position away from enemies and hazards
        for _ in range(20):
            x = random.randint(50, SCREEN_WIDTH - 50)
            y = random.randint(50, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 50)
            test_pos = Vector2D(x, y)
            safe = True
            
            # Check distance to enemies
            for robot in environment.robots:
                if robot.team != self.team and robot.is_alive:
                    if test_pos.distance_to(robot.position) < 100:
                        safe = False
                        break
            
            # Check distance to hazards
            for hazard in environment.hazards:
                if test_pos.distance_to(hazard.position) < hazard.radius + 50:
                    safe = False
                    break
            
            if safe:
                return test_pos
        return None

        if self.ai_state == "combat" and self.target and self.weapon:
            # Use weapon if available and in range
            if self.position.distance_to(self.target.position) <= self.weapon.range:
                if self.cooldown <= 0:
                    # Fire weapon
                    self.weapon.fire(self, self.target, environment)
                    self.cooldown = self.weapon.cooldown
            else:
                # Move toward enemy
                direction = (self.target.position - self.position).normalize()
                self.velocity = direction * 150
                
        elif self.ai_state == "patrol":
            # Patrol between waypoints
            if not hasattr(self, 'patrol_waypoints'):
                self.patrol_waypoints = [
                    Vector2D(random.randint(100, SCREEN_WIDTH - 100), random.randint(100, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 100))
                    for _ in range(3)
                ]
                self.current_waypoint = 0
            
            target = self.patrol_waypoints[self.current_waypoint]
            direction = (target - self.position).normalize()
            distance = self.position.distance_to(target)
            
            if distance < 30:
                self.current_waypoint = (self.current_waypoint + 1) % len(self.patrol_waypoints)
            
            self.velocity = direction * 80
            
        elif self.ai_state == "defend":
            # Defend base
            base_pos = environment.team_bases[self.team]
            direction = (base_pos - self.position).normalize()

            # If enemy nearby, engage
            if nearest_enemy and min_distance < 200:
                self.target = nearest_enemy
                self.ai_state = "combat"
        
        elif self.ai_state == "support":
            # Support teammates
            teammate = self.find_nearest_teammate(environment)
            if teammate and teammate.health < teammate.max_health * 0.5:
                direction = (teammate.position - self.position).normalize()
                self.velocity = direction * 70
                # Use support ability
                if self.weapon and self.weapon.type == WeaponType.SUPPORT and self.cooldown <= 0:
                    self.weapon.fire(self, teammate, environment)
                    self.cooldown = self.weapon.cooldown
            else:
                # Default patrol near base
                base_pos = environment.team_bases[self.team]
                direction = (base_pos - self.position).normalize()
                self.velocity = direction * 60
                
        elif self.ai_state == "scout":
            # Scout the map
            if not hasattr(self, 'scout_waypoints'):
                self.scout_waypoints = [
                    Vector2D(random.randint(100, SCREEN_WIDTH - 100), random.randint(100, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 100))
                    for _ in range(5)
                ]
                self.current_scout_point = 0

            if distance < 50:
                self.current_scout_point = (self.current_scout_point + 1) % len(self.scout_waypoints)
            
            self.velocity = direction * 120
            
        # Handle objectives
        if environment.objective_type == ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE:
            flag_pos = environment.flag_position
            if self.position.distance_to(flag_pos) < 80 and not environment.flag_captured_by:
                # Capture flag
                environment.flag_captured_by = self.team
                self.objective_progress = 1.0
            elif environment.flag_captured_by == self.team:
                # Return flag to base
                base_pos = environment.team_bases[self.team]
                direction = (base_pos - self.position).normalize()
                self.velocity = direction * 60
                
        # Learn from experience
        if self.strategy_memory and len(self.strategy_memory) > 10:
            self.adapt_strategy(environment)
    
    def find_nearest_teammate(self, environment: 'Environment') -> Optional['Robot']:
        nearest = None
        min_distance = float('inf')
        
        for robot in environment.robots:
            if robot.team == self.team and robot.is_alive and robot != self:
                distance = self.position.distance_to(robot.position)
                if distance < min_distance:
                    min_distance = distance
                    nearest = robot
        
        return nearest
    
    def adapt_strategy(self, environment: 'Environment'):
        # Analyze past performance and adjust behavior
        # Simple example: increase aggression if winning, become defensive if losing
        team_score = environment.team_scores[self.team]
        enemy_score = environment.team_scores[1 - self.team]
        
        if team_score > enemy_score:
            # We're winning, become more aggressive
            if self.role == RobotRole.DEFENDER:
                self.role = RobotRole.ATTACKER
        else:
            # We're losing, become more defensive
            if self.role == RobotRole.ATTACKER:
                self.role = RobotRole.DEFENDER
        
        # Adjust strategy based on success rate
        recent_success = sum(1 for m in self.strategy_memory[-5:] if m.get('success', False))
        if recent_success > 3:
            # Good performance, try more complex tactics
            self.ai_state = "complex_attack"
        elif recent_success < 2:
            # Poor performance, simplify tactics
            self.ai_state = "patrol"

@dataclass
class Weapon:
    type: WeaponType
    name: str
    damage: float
    range: float
    ammo: int
    max_ammo: int
    cooldown: float
    projectile_speed: float = 500.0
    fire_sound: str = "pew"
    
    def fire(self, shooter: Robot, target: Robot, environment: 'Environment'):
        if self.ammo <= 0:
            return
            
        self.ammo -= 1
        
        # Create projectile based on weapon type
        if self.type == WeaponType.RANGED:
            # Calculate direction to target
            direction = (target.position - shooter.position).normalize()
            projectile = Projectile(
                shooter.position.copy(), 
                direction * self.projectile_speed, 
                self.damage, 
                shooter.team, 
                projectile_type=self.type
            )
            environment.projectiles.append(projectile)
            
        elif self.type == WeaponType.MELEE:
            # Melee attack - check for targets in range
            for robot in environment.robots:
                if robot.team != shooter.team and robot.is_alive:
                    if shooter.position.distance_to(robot.position) < 80:
                        robot.take_damage(self.damage)
                        # Add visual effect
                        environment.particles.append(Particle(
                            robot.position.x, robot.position.y, COLOR_RED, 10
                        ))
                        
        elif self.type == WeaponType.EXPLOSIVE:
            # Explosive attack - create area effect
            explosion = Explosion(
                shooter.position.copy(), 
                self.damage, 
                100, 
                shooter.team
            )
            environment.explosions.append(explosion)
            
        elif self.type == WeaponType.SUPPORT:
            # Support ability - heal or shield teammate
            if target and target.team == shooter.team and target.is_alive:
                target.heal(self.damage)
                # Add visual effect
                environment.particles.append(Particle(
                    target.position.x, target.position.y, COLOR_GREEN, 15
                ))
        
        # Play sound effect (simulated)
        environment.play_sound(self.fire_sound)

@dataclass
class Projectile:
    position: Vector2D
    velocity: Vector2D
    damage: float
    team: int
    lifetime: float = 3.0
    projectile_type: WeaponType = WeaponType.RANGED
    radius: float = 5.0
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        self.position += self.velocity * delta_time
        self.lifetime -= delta_time
        return self.lifetime > 0

@dataclass
class Explosion:
    position: Vector2D
    damage: float
    radius: float
    team: int
    lifetime: float = 1.5
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float, environment: 'Environment'):
        self.lifetime -= delta_time
        
        # Apply damage to nearby robots
        for robot in environment.robots:
            if robot.is_alive and robot.team != self.team:
                distance = self.position.distance_to(robot.position)
                if distance < self.radius:
                    # Damage decreases with distance
                    damage_factor = 1 - (distance / self.radius)
                    robot.take_damage(self.damage * damage_factor)
                    # Add particle effect
                    environment.particles.append(Particle(
                        robot.position.x, robot.position.y, COLOR_ORANGE, 8
                    ))
        
        return self.lifetime > 0

@dataclass
class Particle:
    x: float
    y: float
    color: Tuple[int, int, int]
    lifetime: float
    velocity: Vector2D = field(default_factory=lambda: Vector2D(
        random.uniform(-50, 50), 
        random.uniform(-50, 50)
    ))
    size: float = 3.0
    decay_rate: float = 0.05
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float) -> bool:
        self.x += self.velocity.x * delta_time
        self.y += self.velocity.y * delta_time
        self.lifetime -= delta_time
        self.size -= self.decay_rate * delta_time
        return self.lifetime > 0 and self.size > 0

@dataclass
class PowerUp:

@dataclass
class Environment:
    robots: List[Robot] = field(default_factory=list)
    projectiles: List[Projectile] = field(default_factory=list)
    explosions: List[Explosion] = field(default_factory=list)
    particles: List[Particle] = field(default_factory=list)
    powerups: List[PowerUp] = field(default_factory=list)
    hazards: List[Hazard] = field(default_factory=list)
    team_bases: Dict[int, Vector2D] = field(default_factory=dict)
    flag_position: Vector2D = field(default_factory=lambda: Vector2D(SCREEN_WIDTH // 2, SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2))
    flag_captured_by: Optional[int] = None
    objective_type: ObjectiveType = ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE
    team_scores: Dict[int, float] = field(default_factory=lambda: {0: 0, 1: 0})
    round_time: float = 0.0
    last_powerup_spawn: float = 0
    last_hazard_spawn: float = 0
    difficulty_level: float = 1.0
    ai_adaptation_cooldown: float = 0
    sound_queue: queue.Queue = field(default_factory=queue.Queue)
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        # Initialize team bases
        self.team_bases[0] = Vector2D(100, SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2)
        self.team_bases[1] = Vector2D(SCREEN_WIDTH - 100, SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2)
        
        # Spawn initial power-ups
        self.spawn_powerups(3)
        
        # Spawn initial hazards
        self.spawn_hazards(2)
    
    def spawn_powerups(self, count: int):
        for _ in range(count):
            x = random.randint(100, SCREEN_WIDTH - 100)
            y = random.randint(100, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 100)
            powerup_type = random.choice(list(PowerUpType))
            self.powerups.append(PowerUp(Vector2D(x, y), powerup_type))
    
    def spawn_hazards(self, count: int):
        for _ in range(count):
            x = random.randint(100, SCREEN_WIDTH - 100)
            y = random.randint(100, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 100)
            hazard_type = random.choice(list(HazardType))
            radius = random.randint(50, 120)
            damage = random.uniform(5, 15)
            self.hazards.append(Hazard(Vector2D(x, y), hazard_type, radius, damage))
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        self.round_time += delta_time
        
        # Update projectiles
        self.projectiles = [p for p in self.projectiles if p.update(delta_time)]
        
        # Update explosions
        self.explosions = [e for e in self.explosions if e.update(delta_time, self)]
        
        # Update particles
        self.particles = [p for p in self.particles if p.update(delta_time)]
        
        # Update power-ups
        self.powerups = [p for p in self.powerups if p.update(delta_time)]
        
        # Update hazards
        self.hazards = [h for h in self.hazards if h.update(delta_time)]
        
        # Spawn new power-ups if needed
        if time.time() - self.last_powerup_spawn > 20:
            self.spawn_powerups(1)
            self.last_powerup_spawn = time.time()
        
        # Spawn new hazards if needed
        if time.time() - self.last_hazard_spawn > 30:
            self.spawn_hazards(1)
            self.last_hazard_spawn = time.time()
        
        # Update AI difficulty based on performance
        if self.ai_adaptation_cooldown <= 0:
            self.adapt_difficulty()
            self.ai_adaptation_cooldown = 10.0  # Cooldown before next adaptation
        
        self.ai_adaptation_cooldown -= delta_time
        
        # Check for objective completion
        self.check_objective_completion()
    
    def adapt_difficulty(self):
        # Calculate average team performance
        team_0_avg = sum(1 for r in self.robots if r.team == 0 and r.is_alive) / ROBOTS_PER_TEAM
        team_1_avg = sum(1 for r in self.robots if r.team == 1 and r.is_alive) / ROBOTS_PER_TEAM
        
        # Adjust difficulty based on team performance
        if team_0_avg > team_1_avg:
            # Team 0 is doing better - make Team 1 slightly stronger
            self.difficulty_level = min(2.0, self.difficulty_level + 0.1)
        elif team_1_avg > team_0_avg:
            # Team 1 is doing better - make Team 0 slightly stronger
            self.difficulty_level = min(2.0, self.difficulty_level + 0.1)
        else:
            # Teams are balanced - reset difficulty slightly
            self.difficulty_level = max(0.5, self.difficulty_level - 0.05)
        
        # Adjust AI behavior based on difficulty
        for robot in self.robots:
            if robot.team == 0:  # Adjust AI for team 0
                robot.max_health = 100 + (self.difficulty_level - 1.0) * 50
                robot.max_energy = 100 + (self.difficulty_level - 1.0) * 30
                robot.armor = 0 + (self.difficulty_level - 1.0) * 40
            else:  # Adjust AI for team 1
                robot.max_health = 100 + (self.difficulty_level - 1.0) * 50
                robot.max_energy = 100 + (self.difficulty_level - 1.0) * 30
                robot.armor = 0 + (self.difficulty_level - 1.0) * 40
    
    def check_objective_completion(self):
        if self.objective_type == ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE:
            if self.flag_captured_by is not None:
                # Flag has been captured
                if self.round_time > 5:  # Must hold flag for 5 seconds
                    self.team_scores[self.flag_captured_by] += 10
                    self.objective_type = ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE  # Reset
                    self.flag_captured_by = None
                    self.flag_position = Vector2D(
                        random.randint(100, SCREEN_WIDTH - 100), 
                        random.randint(100, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 100)
                    )
                    
        elif self.objective_type == ObjectiveType.ELIMINATION:
            team0_alive = sum(1 for r in self.robots if r.team == 0 and r.is_alive)
            team1_alive = sum(1 for r in self.robots if r.team == 1 and r.is_alive)
            
            if team0_alive == 0:
                self.team_scores[1] += 20
                self.objective_type = ObjectiveType.ELIMINATION
            elif team1_alive == 0:
                self.team_scores[0] += 20
                self.objective_type = ObjectiveType.ELIMINATION
    
    def play_sound(self, sound_name: str):
        # In a real implementation, this would play an audio file
        # Here we simulate sound with a queue for potential audio system integration
        self.sound_queue.put(sound_name)

# =============================

class MLStrategyEngine:
    def __init__(self, model_path: str = "ml_model.pkl"):
        self.model_path = model_path
        self.feature_names = [
            'avg_player_score', 'team_score_variance', 'role_balance',
            'turn_efficiency', 'recent_improvement', 'risk_ratio'
        ]
        self.model = None
        self.is_trained = False
        self.training_data = []
        self.load_model()

    def extract_features(self, team: Team, game_session: GameSession) -> List[float]:
        if not team.players:
            return [0.0] * len(self.feature_names)
        
        scores = [p.historical_scores[-1] if p.historical_scores else 0.0 for p in team.players]
        avg_score = np.mean(scores) if scores else 0.0
        score_variance = np.std(scores) if len(scores) > 1 else 0.0
        
        role_counts = defaultdict(int)
        for p in team.players:
            role_counts[p.role] += 1
        role_balance = min(role_counts.values()) / max(1, max(role_counts.values()))
        
        # Turn efficiency: how often team scores on their turn
        turn_scores = [entry['scores'][team.id] for entry in game_session.game_history if team.id in entry['scores']]
        turn_efficiency = sum(1 for s in turn_scores if s > 0) / max(1, len(turn_scores))
        
        # Recent improvement: compare last 3 rounds to first 3
        if len(team.performance_history) >= 6:
            early_scores = [h['score'] for h in team.performance_history[:3]]
            recent_scores = [h['score'] for h in team.performance_history[-3:]]
            recent_improvement = np.mean(recent_scores) - np.mean(early_scores)
        else:
            recent_improvement = 0.0
        
        # Risk ratio: proportion of high-risk moves made (simulated via score variance)
        risk_ratio = score_variance / max(1, avg_score)
        
        return [
            avg_score,
            score_variance,
            role_balance,
            turn_efficiency,
            recent_improvement,
            risk_ratio
        ]

    def generate_suggestions(self, team: Team, game_session: GameSession) -> List[str]:
        if not self.is_trained:
            return [
                "Consider rotating roles to improve balance.",
                "Try coordinating decisions faster during turns.",
                "Analyze your scoring patterns with other teams."
            ]
        
        features = self.extract_features(team, game_session)
        suggestions = []
        
        # Rule-based suggestions based on features
        if features[2] < 0.5:  # role_balance
            suggestions.append("Team role distribution is unbalanced. Assign more players to Leader or Strategist roles.")
        
        if features[3] < 0.3:  # turn_efficiency
            suggestions.append("Your team scores infrequently on turns. Improve coordination and decision-making speed.")
        
        if features[4] < -1.0:  # recent_improvement
            suggestions.append("Your team's performance is declining. Reassess strategy or try new roles.")
        
        if features[5] > 2.0:  # risk_ratio
            suggestions.append("Your team takes high-risk moves with low reward. Focus on consistent scoring.")
        
        if not suggestions:
            suggestions.append("Your team is performing well! Maintain current strategy.")
        
        return suggestions

    def train(self, game_sessions: List[GameSession]) -> bool:
        if len(game_sessions) < 2:
            return False
        
        X, y = [], []
        for session in game_sessions:
            for team in session.teams:
                for perf in team.performance_history:
                    features = self.extract_features(team, session)
                    # Target: next round score improvement
                    next_score = perf.get('score', 0)
                    y.append(next_score)
                    X.append(features)
        
        if len(X) < 10:
            return False
        
        # Simple linear regression model (could be replaced with sklearn)
        X_np = np.array(X)
        y_np = np.array(y)
        
        # Compute weights via least squares
        self.model = np.linalg.lstsq(X_np, y_np, rcond=None)[0]
        self.is_trained = True
        
        # Save model
        with open(self.model_path, 'wb') as f:
            pickle.dump(self.model, f)
        
        return True

    def load_model(self):
        try:
            with open(self.model_path, 'rb') as f:
                self.model = pickle.load(f)
                self.is_trained = True
        except FileNotFoundError:

@dataclass
class Vector2D:
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def __truediv__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x / scalar, self.y / scalar)
    
    def magnitude(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        mag = self.magnitude()
        if mag == 0:
            return Vector2D(0, 0)
        return Vector2D(self.x / mag, self.y / mag)
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).magnitude()
    
    def copy(self):
        return Vector2D(self.x, self.y)

@dataclass
class Weapon:
    type: WeaponType
    name: str
    damage: float
    range: float
    ammo: int
    max_ammo: int
    cooldown: float
    projectile_speed: float = 500.0
    fire_sound: str = "pew"
    
    def fire(self, shooter: Robot, target: Robot, environment: 'Environment'):
        if self.ammo <= 0:
            return
            
        self.ammo -= 1
        
        # Create projectile based on weapon type
        if self.type == WeaponType.RANGED:
            # Calculate direction to target
            direction = (target.position - shooter.position).normalize()
            projectile = Projectile(
                shooter.position.copy(), 
                direction * self.projectile_speed, 
                self.damage, 
                shooter.team, 
                projectile_type=self.type
            )
            environment.projectiles.append(projectile)
            
        elif self.type == WeaponType.MELEE:
            # Melee attack - check for targets in range
            for robot in environment.robots:
                if robot.team != shooter.team and robot.is_alive:
                    if shooter.position.distance_to(robot.position) < 80:
                        robot.take_damage(self.damage)
                        # Add visual effect
                        environment.particles.append(Particle(
                            robot.position.x, robot.position.y, COLOR_RED, 10
                        ))
                        
        elif self.type == WeaponType.EXPLOSIVE:
            # Explosive attack - create area effect
            explosion = Explosion(
                shooter.position.copy(), 
                self.damage, 
                100, 
                shooter.team
            )
            environment.explosions.append(explosion)
            
        elif self.type == WeaponType.SUPPORT:
            # Support ability - heal or shield teammate
            if target and target.team == shooter.team and target.is_alive:
                target.heal(self.damage)
                # Add visual effect
                environment.particles.append(Particle(
                    target.position.x, target.position.y, COLOR_GREEN, 15
                ))
        
        # Play sound effect (simulated)
        environment.play_sound(self.fire_sound)

@dataclass
class Projectile:
    position: Vector2D
    velocity: Vector2D
    damage: float
    team: int
    lifetime: float = 3.0
    projectile_type: WeaponType = WeaponType.RANGED
    radius: float = 5.0
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        self.position += self.velocity * delta_time
        self.lifetime -= delta_time
        return self.lifetime > 0

@dataclass
class Explosion:
    position: Vector2D
    damage: float
    radius: float
    team: int
    lifetime: float = 1.5
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float, environment: 'Environment'):
        self.lifetime -= delta_time
        
        # Apply damage to nearby robots
        for robot in environment.robots:
            if robot.is_alive and robot.team != self.team:
                distance = self.position.distance_to(robot.position)
                if distance < self.radius:
                    # Damage decreases with distance
                    damage_factor = 1 - (distance / self.radius)
                    robot.take_damage(self.damage * damage_factor)
                    # Add particle effect
                    environment.particles.append(Particle(
                        robot.position.x, robot.position.y, COLOR_ORANGE, 8
                    ))
        
        return self.lifetime > 0

@dataclass
class Particle:
    x: float
    y: float
    color: Tuple[int, int, int]
    lifetime: float
    velocity: Vector2D = field(default_factory=lambda: Vector2D(
        random.uniform(-50, 50), 
        random.uniform(-50, 50)
    ))
    size: float = 3.0
    decay_rate: float = 0.05
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float) -> bool:
        self.x += self.velocity.x * delta_time
        self.y += self.velocity.y * delta_time
        self.lifetime -= delta_time
        self.size -= self.decay_rate * delta_time
        return self.lifetime > 0 and self.size > 0

@dataclass
class Vector2:
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        return Vector2(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def length(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        length = self.length()
        if length == 0:
            return Vector2(0, 0)
        return Vector2(self.x / length, self.y / length)
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).length()

        self.health = min(self.max_health, self.health + amount)

@dataclass
class Weapon:
    type: WeaponType
    damage: float
    fire_rate: float  # shots per second
    range: float  # maximum range
    reload_time: float  # seconds to reload
    accuracy: float  # 0.0 to 1.0, higher is more accurate
    
    def can_fire(self, last_fired: float, current_time: float) -> bool:
        return current_time - last_fired >= (1.0 / self.fire_rate)
    
    def get_actual_damage(self) -> float:
        """Apply damage variance based on weapon type"""
        if self.type == WeaponType.RANGED:
            return self.damage * random.uniform(0.8, 1.2)
        elif self.type == WeaponType.MELEE:
            return self.damage * random.uniform(0.9, 1.1)
        else:  # SUPPORT
            return self.damage

@dataclass
class Objective:
    id: str
    type: ObjectType
    position: Vector2
    team: Team
    capture_progress: float = 0.0
    is_captured: bool = False
    capture_time: float = 0.0
    health: float = 100.0
    max_health: float = 100.0
    required_robots: int = 1
    radius: float = 5.0
    owner_team: Optional[Team] = None
    
    def is_within_range(self, robot_position: Vector2) -> bool:
        """Check if robot is within objective's capture range"""
        return robot_position.distance_to(self.position) <= self.radius
    
    def capture(self, robot_team: Team, progress_amount: float = 0.1) -> bool:
        """Attempt to capture objective"""
        if self.type == ObjectType.FLAG and self.is_captured and self.owner_team == robot_team:
            return False  # Already captured by same team
            
        # Update capture progress
        self.capture_progress += progress_amount
        
        # Check if objective is captured
        if self.capture_progress >= 1.0:
            self.is_captured = True
            self.capture_time = time.time()
            self.owner_team = robot_team
            self.capture_progress = 1.0
            logger.info(f"Objective {self.id} captured by {robot_team.value}")
            return True
            
        return False
    
    def reset_capture(self) -> None:
        """Reset capture progress"""
        self.capture_progress = 0.0
        self.is_captured = False
        self.owner_team = None

@dataclass
class Vector2:
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        return Vector2(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def length(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        length = self.length()
        if length == 0:
            return Vector2(0, 0)
        return Vector2(self.x / length, self.y / length)
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).length()

        """Attempt to capture objective"""
        if self.type == ObjectType.FLAG and self.is_captured and self.owner_team == robot_team:
            return False  # Already captured by same team

        self.capture_progress += progress_amount
        
        # Check if objective is captured
        if self.capture_progress >= 1.0:

            self.capture_time = time.time()
            self.owner_team = robot_team
            self.capture_progress = 1.0
            logger.info(f"Objective {self.id} captured by {robot_team.value}")

    PAUSED = "paused"
    FINISHED = "finished"

@dataclass
class Vector2:
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        return Vector2(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def length(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        length = self.length()
        if length == 0:
            return Vector2(0, 0)
        return Vector2(self.x / length, self.y / length)
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).length()

@dataclass
class Robot:
    id: str
    team: Team
    position: Vector2 = field(default_factory=lambda: Vector2(0, 0))
    velocity: Vector2 = field(default_factory=lambda: Vector2(0, 0))
    health: float = 100.0
    max_health: float = 100.0
    speed: float = 5.0
    weapon: 'Weapon' = None
    role: RobotRole = RobotRole.ATTACKER
    last_action_time: float = 0.0
    cooldowns: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)
    perception_range: float = 20.0
    team_cooperation_score: float = 0.0
    learning_data: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    is_alive: bool = True
    power_ups: List[PowerUpType] = field(default_factory=list)
    last_seen_enemies: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    objectives: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.weapon is None:
            self.weapon = Weapon(WeaponType.RANGED, 25, 1.0, 30.0, 5.0, 1.5)
        
        # Initialize cooldowns for common actions
        self.cooldowns = {
            "attack": 0,
            "ability": 0,
            "reload": 0,
            "dash": 0
        }
    
    def take_damage(self, damage: float) -> bool:
        """Apply damage to robot and return True if robot died"""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return False
            
        self.health -= damage
        if self.health <= 0:
            self.health = 0
            self.is_alive = False
            logger.info(f"Robot {self.id} has been eliminated!")
            return True
        return False
    
    def heal(self, amount: float) -> None:
        """Heal robot by specified amount"""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return
        self.health = min(self.max_health, self.health + amount)
    
    def add_power_up(self, power_up: PowerUpType) -> None:
        """Add a power-up to the robot"""
        if power_up not in self.power_ups:
            self.power_ups.append(power_up)
            logger.info(f"Robot {self.id} picked up {power_up.value} power-up")
    
    def remove_power_up(self, power_up: PowerUpType) -> bool:
        """Remove a specific power-up and return True if removed"""
        if power_up in self.power_ups:
            self.power_ups.remove(power_up)
            return True
        return False
    
    def has_power_up(self, power_up_type: PowerUpType) -> bool:
        """Check if robot has a specific power-up"""
        return power_up_type in self.power_ups
    
    def update_cooldowns(self, dt: float) -> None:
        """Update all cooldowns based on time elapsed"""
        for key in self.cooldowns:
            if self.cooldowns[key] > 0:
                self.cooldowns[key] -= dt
    
    def can_attack(self) -> bool:
        """Check if robot can attack (not in cooldown)"""
        return self.cooldowns["attack"] <= 0
    
    def can_use_ability(self) -> bool:
        """Check if robot can use special ability"""
        return self.cooldowns["ability"] <= 0
    
    def can_dash(self) -> bool:
        """Check if robot can dash"""
        return self.cooldowns["dash"] <= 0
    
    def set_role(self, role: RobotRole) -> None:
        """Set robot's role and update behavior parameters"""
        self.role = role
        # Adjust behavior based on role
        if role == RobotRole.ATTACKER:
            self.perception_range = 25.0
            self.speed = 5.5
        elif role == RobotRole.DEFENDER:
            self.perception_range = 30.0
            self.speed = 4.0
            self.max_health = 120.0
            self.health = min(self.health, self.max_health)
        elif role == RobotRole.SUPPORT:
            self.perception_range = 35.0
            self.speed = 4.5
        elif role == RobotRole.SCOUT:
            self.perception_range = 40.0
            self.speed = 6.0
        elif role == RobotRole.CONTROLLER:
            self.perception_range = 30.0
            self.speed = 4.2
    
    def get_state(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Return a serializable state for learning"""
        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "team": self.team.value,
            "position": {"x": self.position.x, "y": self.position.y},
            "health": self.health,
            "max_health": self.max_health,
            "speed": self.speed,
            "role": self.role.value,
            "is_alive": self.is_alive,
            "power_ups": [p.value for p in self.power_ups],
            "last_seen_enemies": self.last_seen_enemies,
            "team_cooperation_score": self.team_cooperation_score,
            "objectives": self.objectives
        }

@dataclass
class Weapon:
    type: WeaponType
    damage: float
    fire_rate: float  # shots per second
    range: float  # maximum range
    reload_time: float  # seconds to reload
    accuracy: float  # 0.0 to 1.0, higher is more accurate
    
    def can_fire(self, last_fired: float, current_time: float) -> bool:
        return current_time - last_fired >= (1.0 / self.fire_rate)
    
    def get_actual_damage(self) -> float:
        """Apply damage variance based on weapon type"""
        if self.type == WeaponType.RANGED:
            return self.damage * random.uniform(0.8, 1.2)
        elif self.type == WeaponType.MELEE:
            return self.damage * random.uniform(0.9, 1.1)
        else:  # SUPPORT
            return self.damage

@dataclass
class Objective:
    id: str
    type: ObjectType
    position: Vector2
    team: Team
    capture_progress: float = 0.0
    is_captured: bool = False
    capture_time: float = 0.0
    health: float = 100.0
    max_health: float = 100.0
    required_robots: int = 1
    radius: float = 5.0
    owner_team: Optional[Team] = None
    
    def is_within_range(self, robot_position: Vector2) -> bool:
        """Check if robot is within objective's capture range"""
        return robot_position.distance_to(self.position) <= self.radius
    
    def capture(self, robot_team: Team, progress_amount: float = 0.1) -> bool:
        """Attempt to capture objective"""
        if self.type == ObjectType.FLAG and self.is_captured and self.owner_team == robot_team:
            return False  # Already captured by same team
            
        # Update capture progress
        self.capture_progress += progress_amount
        
        # Check if objective is captured
        if self.capture_progress >= 1.0:
            self.is_captured = True
            self.capture_time = time.time()
            self.owner_team = robot_team
            self.capture_progress = 1.0
            logger.info(f"Objective {self.id} captured by {robot_team.value}")
            return True
            
        return False
    
    def reset_capture(self) -> None:
        """Reset capture progress"""
        self.capture_progress = 0.0
        self.is_captured = False
        self.owner_team = None

@dataclass
class PowerUp:
    type: PowerUpType
    position: Vector2
    duration: float = 10.0  # seconds
    spawn_time: float = 0.0
    active: bool = True
    radius: float = 3.0
    
    def is_collected(self, robot_position: Vector2) -> bool:
        """Check if robot has collected this power-up"""
        return self.active and self.position.distance_to(robot_position) <= self.radius
    
    def get_effect_description(self) -> str:
        """Return description of power-up effect"""
        descriptions = {
            PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST: "Increases movement speed by 50% for 10 seconds",
            PowerUpType.DAMAGE_BOOST: "Increases weapon damage by 30% for 10 seconds",
            PowerUpType.SHIELD: "Grants temporary damage absorption shield for 8 seconds",
            PowerUpType.REGEN: "Regenerates 5 health per second for 15 seconds",
            PowerUpType.TELEPORT: "Instantly teleports to a random location",
            PowerUpType.SILENCE: "Disables enemy weapons for 5 seconds"
        }
        return descriptions.get(self.type, "")

@dataclass
class Hazard:
