class AIController:
    def __init__(self, game_state: GameState):
        self.game_state = game_state
        self.last_decision_time = 0.0
        self.decision_cooldown = 0.5  # Seconds between AI decisions
        self.learning_rate = 0.1
        self.exploration_rate = 0.3  # Chance to explore new strategies
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float) -> None:
        """Update all AI robots"""
        current_time = self.game_state.time
        if current_time - self.last_decision_time < self.decision_cooldown:
            return
            
        self.last_decision_time = current_time
        self._update_ai_robots(delta_time)
    
    def _update_ai_robots(self, delta_time: float) -> None:
        """Update AI behaviors for all robots"""
        for robot in self.game_state.robots:
            if not robot.is_alive or robot.team == Team.NEUTRAL:
                continue
            
            # Update power-ups
            robot.update_power_ups(delta_time)
            
            # Update weapon cooldown
            if robot.weapon_cooldown > 0:
                robot.weapon_cooldown -= delta_time
            
            # Update robot role based on team situation
            self._assign_role(robot)
            
            # Execute AI decision
            self._make_decision(robot, delta_time)
    
    def _assign_role(self, robot: Robot) -> None:
        """Dynamically assign roles based on team composition and game state"""
        team_robots = self.game_state.get_team_robots(robot.team)
        alive_robots = [r for r in team_robots if r.is_alive]
        
        # Count roles
        roles = {
            RobotType.SCOUT: sum(1 for r in alive_robots if r.robot_type == RobotType.SCOUT),
            RobotType.SOLDIER: sum(1 for r in alive_robots if r.robot_type == RobotType.SOLDIER),
            RobotType.HEAVY: sum(1 for r in alive_robots if r.robot_type == RobotType.HEAVY),
            RobotType.SUPPORT: sum(1 for r in alive_robots if r.robot_type == RobotType.SUPPORT),
            RobotType.ENGINEER: sum(1 for r in alive_robots if r.robot_type == RobotType.ENGINEER)
        }
        
        # Default role assignment
        if roles[RobotType.SUPPORT] == 0 and robot.robot_type == RobotType.SUPPORT:
            robot.role = "support"
        elif roles[RobotType.ENGINEER] == 0 and robot.robot_type == RobotType.ENGINEER:
            robot.role = "engineer"
        elif roles[RobotType.HEAVY] == 0 and robot.robot_type == RobotType.HEAVY:
            robot.role = "heavy"
        elif robot.robot_type == RobotType.SCOUT:
            robot.role = "scout"
        else:
            robot.role = "default"
        
        # Adjust role based on current situation
        objectives = [obj for obj in self.game_state.objectives if not obj.is_captured()]
        if objectives:
            nearest_obj = self.game_state.get_nearest_objective(robot)
            if nearest_obj:
                # If objective is enemy's and we're not the only one, become attacker
                if nearest_obj.team != robot.team and len([r for r in alive_robots if r.role == "attacker"]) < len(alive_robots) // 2:
                    if robot.robot_type != RobotType.SUPPORT:
                        robot.role = "attacker"
                # If objective is our own, become defender
                elif nearest_obj.team == robot.team:
                    robot.role = "defender"
        
        # If teammates are low on health, become support if possible
        if robot.robot_type == RobotType.SUPPORT:
            low_health_teammates = [r for r in alive_robots if r.team == robot.team and r.health < r.max_health * 0.5]
            if len(low_health_teammates) > 0:
                robot.role = "support"
    
    def _make_decision(self, robot: Robot, delta_time: float) -> None:
        """AI decision-making process using adaptive strategy"""
        if not robot.is_alive:
            return
        
        # Get important targets
        targets = self.game_state.get_important_targets(robot)
        
        # Base movement
        target_pos = robot.position  # Default: stay in place
        
        # Use strategy memory to adapt to previous battles
        strategy = self._choose_strategy(robot, targets)
        
        # Execute strategy
        if strategy == "attack":
            # Attack nearest enemy
            enemy = self.game_state.get_nearest_enemy(robot)
            if enemy:
                target_pos = enemy.position
                if self._can_attack(robot, enemy):
                    self._attack(robot, enemy)
                else:
                    # Move toward enemy
                    direction = enemy.position - robot.position
                    if direction.x != 0 or direction.y != 0:
                        normalized = direction.normalize()
                        move_dist = robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time
                        robot.position.x += normalized.x * move_dist
                        robot.position.y += normalized.y * move_dist
            else:
                # No enemy in sight, move toward objective
                nearest_obj = self.game_state.get_nearest_objective(robot)
                if nearest_obj:
                    target_pos = nearest_obj.position
                    direction = nearest_obj.position - robot.position
                    if direction.x != 0 or direction.y != 0:
                        normalized = direction.normalize()
                        move_dist = robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time
                        robot.position.x += normalized.x * move_dist
                        robot.position.y += normalized.y * move_dist
        
        elif strategy == "defend":
            # Defend objective
            nearest_obj = self.game_state.get_nearest_objective(robot)
            if nearest_obj and nearest_obj.team == robot.team:
                target_pos = nearest_obj.position
                # If enemy nearby, attack
                enemy = self.game_state.get_nearest_enemy(robot)
                if enemy and self._can_attack(robot, enemy):
                    self._attack(robot, enemy)
                else:
                    # Move to objective position
                    direction = nearest_obj.position - robot.position
                    if direction.x != 0 or direction.y != 0:
                        normalized = direction.normalize()
                        move_dist = robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time
                        robot.position.x += normalized.x * move_dist
                        robot.position.y += normalized.y * move_dist
            else:
                # Default to attack if no objective to defend
                self._make_decision(robot, delta_time)
        
        elif strategy == "support":
            # Heal or buff teammate
            teammates = [r for r in self.game_state.robots if r.team == robot.team and r.is_alive and r.id != robot.id]
            if teammates:
                # Find most in need
                teammate = min(teammates, key=lambda t: t.health / t.max_health)
                if teammate.health < teammate.max_health * 0.5:
                    # Move to teammate
                    target_pos = teammate.position
                    direction = teammate.position - robot.position
                    if direction.x != 0 or direction.y != 0:
                        normalized = direction.normalize()
                        move_dist = robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time
                        robot.position.x += normalized.x * move_dist
                        robot.position.y += normalized.y * move_dist
                    # If close enough, heal
                    if robot.position.distance_to(teammate.position) < 15:
                        if robot.robot_type == RobotType.SUPPORT:
                            teammate.heal(5.0)
                            robot.use_energy(10.0)
            
        elif strategy == "engineer":
            # Engineer: repair or place defenses
            teammates = [r for r in self.game_state.robots if r.team == robot.team and r.is_alive and r.id != robot.id]
            if teammates:
                # Find most damaged teammate
                teammate = min(teammates, key=lambda t: t.health / t.max_health)
                if teammate.health < teammate.max_health * 0.7:
                    target_pos = teammate.position
                    direction = teammate.position - robot.position
                    if direction.x != 0 or direction.y != 0:
                        normalized = direction.normalize()
                        move_dist = robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time
                        robot.position.x += normalized.x * move_dist
                        robot.position.y += normalized.y * move_dist
                    # Repair if close
                    if robot.position.distance_to(teammate.position) < 15:
                        # Engineer can repair
                        heal_amount = 2.0
                        teammate.heal(heal_amount)
                        robot.use_energy(5.0)
        
        elif strategy == "scout":
            # Scout: explore and find enemies
            nearest_obj = self.game_state.get_nearest_objective(robot)
            if nearest_obj:
                target_pos = nearest_obj.position
                # Move toward objective, but with more aggressive exploration
                direction = nearest_obj.position - robot.position
                if direction.x != 0 or direction.y != 0:
                    normalized = direction.normalize()
                    move_dist = robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time * 1.2  # Scout moves faster
                    robot.position.x += normalized.x * move_dist
                    robot.position.y += normalized.y * move_dist
        
        # Move toward target if needed
        if robot.position.distance_to(target_pos) > 2.0:
            direction = target_pos - robot.position
            if direction.x != 0 or direction.y != 0:
                normalized = direction.normalize()
                move_dist = robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time
                robot.position.x += normalized.x * move_dist
                robot.position.y += normalized.y * move_dist
        
        # Clamp position to map boundaries
        map_x, map_y = self.game_state.map_size
        robot.position.x = max(0, min(map_x, robot.position.x))
        robot.position.y = max(0, min(map_y, robot.position.y))
    
    def _choose_strategy(self, robot: Robot, targets: List[Dict]) -> str:
        """Choose the best strategy based on game state and learning"""
        if not targets:
            return "patrol"
        
        # Check if we have memory of successful strategies
        if robot.strategy_memory:
            # Calculate success rate for each strategy
            strategy_success = defaultdict(list)
            for entry in robot.strategy_memory:
                strategy_success[entry['strategy']].append(entry['outcome'])
            
            # Calculate average success rate
            best_strategy = None
            best_avg = -1
            for strategy, outcomes in strategy_success.items():
                if outcomes:
                    avg_success = sum(outcomes) / len(outcomes)
                    if avg_success > best_avg:
                        best_avg = avg_success
                        best_strategy = strategy
            
            # Exploit best strategy or explore randomly
            if random.random() > self.exploration_rate and best_strategy:
                return best_strategy
        
        # Default strategy selection based on current situation
        for target in targets:
            if target['type'] == 'enemy':
                # If weapon is ready and enemy is in range, attack
                if self._can_attack(robot, target['robot']):
                    return "attack"
                # If enemy is close but weapon not ready, move closer
                elif target['distance'] < 30:
                    return "attack"
            
            elif target['type'] == 'objective':
                if target['objective'].team != robot.team:
                    # Enemy objective - capture or attack
                    if target['distance'] < 40:
                        return "attack"
                    else:
                        return "attack"
                else:
                    # Our objective - defend
                    return "defend"
            
            elif target['type'] == 'power_up':
                # Collect power-up if close
                if target['distance'] < 20:
                    return "collect_powerup"
            
            elif target['type'] == 'teammate':
                # Help teammate in need
                if target['distance'] < 30:
                    if robot.robot_type == RobotType.SUPPORT:
                        return "support"
                    elif robot.robot_type == RobotType.ENGINEER:
                        return "engineer"
        
        # Default behavior
        if robot.robot_type == RobotType.SUPPORT:
            return "support"
        elif robot.robot_type == RobotType.ENGINEER:
            return "engineer"
        elif robot.robot_type == RobotType.SCOUT:
            return "scout"
        else:
            return "attack"
    
    def _can_attack(self, robot: Robot, target: Robot) -> bool:
        """Check if robot can attack the target"""
        if not robot.is_alive or not target.is_alive:
            return False
        
        distance = robot.position.distance_to(target.position)
        
        # Weapon ranges
        weapon_ranges = {
            WeaponType.PISTOL: 40.0,
            WeaponType.RIFLE: 80.0,
            WeaponType.SHOTGUN: 20.0,
            WeaponType.SNIPER: 150.0,
            WeaponType.LAUNCHER: 60.0,
            WeaponType.MELEE: 10.0,
            WeaponType.EMP: 50.0
        }
        
        range_limit = weapon_ranges.get(robot.weapon, 40.0)
        
        # Check if target is in range
        if distance > range_limit:
            return False
        
        # Check cooldown
        if robot.weapon_cooldown > 0:
            return False
        
        # Check ammo (if applicable)
        if robot.weapon != WeaponType.MELEE and robot.weapon != WeaponType.EMP:
            if robot.weapon_ammo <= 0:
                return False
        
        # EMP has special conditions
        if robot.weapon == WeaponType.EMP:
            # EMP works on any robot in range, but has cooldown
            return True
        
        return True
    
    def _attack(self, robot: Robot, target: Robot) -> None:
        """Execute attack on target"""
        if not self._can_attack(robot, target):
            return
        
        # Calculate damage based on weapon and difficulty
        base_damage = {
            WeaponType.PISTOL: 10,
            WeaponType.RIFLE: 15,
            WeaponType.SHOTGUN: 30,
            WeaponType.SNIPER: 50,
            WeaponType.LAUNCHER: 40,
            WeaponType.MELEE: 25,
            WeaponType.EMP: 0  # EMP doesn't deal damage, it disables
        }
        
        damage = base_damage.get(robot.weapon, 10)
        
        # Apply difficulty multiplier
        damage *= (0.8 + self.game_state.difficulty * 0.4)
        
        # Apply power-up effects
        if PowerUpType.SUPER_WEAPON in robot.power_ups:
            damage *= 2.0
        
        # Special handling for EMP
        if robot.weapon == WeaponType.EMP:
            target.weapon_cooldown = 5.0  # Disable for 5 seconds
            logger.info(f"Robot {robot.id} used EMP on Robot {target.id}!")
            robot.use_energy(20.0)
        else:
            # Regular attack
            target.take_damage(damage)
            
            # Reduce ammo
            if robot.weapon != WeaponType.MELEE:
                robot.weapon_ammo -= 1
                if robot.weapon_ammo <= 0:
                    # Recharge ammo
                    robot.weapon_ammo = robot.max_ammo
                    logger.info(f"Robot {robot.id} reloaded!")
            
            # Reset cooldown
            cooldowns = {
                WeaponType.PISTOL: 0.2,
                WeaponType.RIFLE: 0.4,
                WeaponType.SHOTGUN: 0.8,
                WeaponType.SNIPER: 1.5,
                WeaponType.LAUNCHER: 2.0,
                WeaponType.MELEE: 1.0,
                WeaponType.EMP: 10.0
            }
            
            robot.weapon_cooldown = cooldowns.get(robot.weapon, 0.5)
            
            # Reward for successful hit
            if target.health > 0:
                self._update_strategy_memory(robot, "attack", 0.7)
            else:
                self._update_strategy_memory(robot, "attack", 1.0)
        
        # Play sound effect (simulated)
        logger.info(f"Robot {robot.id} attacked Robot {target.id} with {robot.weapon.value} for {damage} damage!")
    
    def _update_strategy_memory(self, robot: Robot, strategy: str, outcome: float) -> None:
        """Update strategy memory with outcome (0.0 to 1.0)"""
        if len(robot.strategy_memory) > 10:  # Limit memory size
            robot.strategy_memory.pop(0)
        
        robot.strategy_memory.append({
            'strategy': strategy,
            'outcome': outcome,
            'timestamp': self.game_state.time
        })

class CyberArena:
    def __init__(self, num_robots: int = 12, map_size: Tuple[float, float] = (500.0, 500.0)):
        self.game_state = GameState(map_size=map_size)
        self.ai_controller = AIController(self.game_state)
        self.num_robots = num_robots
        self.spawn_points = []
        self._initialize_map()

@dataclass
class Position:
    x: float
    y: float
    
    def distance_to(self, other: 'Position') -> float:
        return math.sqrt((self.x - other.x)**2 + (self.y - other.y)**2)
    
    def __add__(self, other: 'Position') -> 'Position':
        return Position(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other: 'Position') -> 'Position':
        return Position(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def normalize(self) -> 'Position':
        magnitude = math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
        if magnitude == 0:
            return Position(0, 0)
        return Position(self.x / magnitude, self.y / magnitude)

@dataclass

    def take_damage(self, damage: float) -> bool:

        if not self.is_alive:
            return False
        self.health = max(0, self.health - damage)
        if self.health <= 0:
            self.is_alive = False
            logger.info(f"Robot {self.id} ({self.team.value}) has been eliminated!")
            return True
        return False
    
    def heal(self, amount: float) -> None:
        """Heal the robot by the specified amount"""
        if self.is_alive:
            self.health = min(self.max_health, self.health + amount)
    
    def use_energy(self, amount: float) -> bool:
        """Use energy, return True if enough energy"""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return False
        if self.energy >= amount:
            self.energy -= amount
            return True
        return False
    
    def recharge_energy(self, amount: float) -> None:

    def add_power_up(self, power_up: PowerUpType, duration: float) -> None:

    def update_power_ups(self, delta_time: float) -> None:

        expired = []
        for power_up, duration in self.power_ups.items():

            if self.power_ups[power_up] <= 0:

@dataclass
class Objective:
    id: int
    obj_type: ObjectiveType
    position: Position
    team: Team
    captured_by: Optional[Team] = None
    progress: float = 0.0  # 0.0 to 1.0
    radius: float = 10.0
    capture_rate: float = 0.01  # per second
    defenders: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)  # Robot IDs defending this objective
    attackers: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)  # Robot IDs attacking this objective
    
    def is_captured(self) -> bool:
        return self.captured_by is not None
    
    def capture_progress(self, robot: Robot, delta_time: float) -> None:
        """Update capture progress based on robots in range"""
        if self.is_captured():
            return
            
        # Check if robots of our team are in range
        if robot.team == self.team:
            # Friendly robots contribute to capture
            if self.position.distance_to(robot.position) <= self.radius:
                self.progress += self.capture_rate * delta_time
                if robot.id not in self.defenders:
                    self.defenders.append(robot.id)
                # Remove from attackers if present
                if robot.id in self.attackers:
                    self.attackers.remove(robot.id)
        else:
            # Enemy robots contribute to capture (reverse)
            if self.position.distance_to(robot.position) <= self.radius:
                self.progress -= self.capture_rate * delta_time
                if robot.id not in self.attackers:
                    self.attackers.append(robot.id)
                # Remove from defenders if present
                if robot.id in self.defenders:
                    self.defenders.remove(robot.id)
        
        # Clamp progress
        self.progress = max(0.0, min(1.0, self.progress))
        
        # Capture if progress reaches 1.0
        if self.progress >= 1.0 and self.team != robot.team:
            self.captured_by = robot.team
            logger.info(f"Objective {self.id} ({self.obj_type.value}) captured by {robot.team.value}!")
        
        # Reset if enemy captures it
        if self.captured_by and self.captured_by != self.team:
            self.team = self.captured_by

@dataclass
class Position:
    x: float
    y: float
    
    def distance_to(self, other: 'Position') -> float:
        return math.sqrt((self.x - other.x)**2 + (self.y - other.y)**2)
    
    def __add__(self, other: 'Position') -> 'Position':
        return Position(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other: 'Position') -> 'Position':
        return Position(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def normalize(self) -> 'Position':
        magnitude = math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
        if magnitude == 0:
            return Position(0, 0)
        return Position(self.x / magnitude, self.y / magnitude)

        if self.progress >= 1.0 and self.team != robot.team:
            self.captured_by = robot.team
            logger.info(f"Objective {self.id} ({self.obj_type.value}) captured by {robot.team.value}!")
        
        # Reset if enemy captures it
        if self.captured_by and self.captured_by != self.team:
            self.team = self.captured_by

@dataclass
class PowerUp:
    id: int
    power_type: PowerUpType
    position: Position
    spawn_time: float
    duration: float = 30.0  # How long it lasts once spawned
    collected: bool = False
    radius: float = 5.0
    
    def is_collected_by(self, robot: Robot) -> bool:
        """Check if robot collected this power-up"""
        if self.collected:
            return False
        if self.position.distance_to(robot.position) <= self.radius:
            self.collected = True
            robot.add_power_up(self.power_type, self.duration)
            logger.info(f"Robot {robot.id} collected {self.power_type.value} power-up!")
            return True
        return False

@dataclass
class Hazard:
    id: int
    hazard_type: HazardType
    position: Position
    radius: float
    damage_per_second: float
    active: bool = True
    
    def affect_robot(self, robot: Robot) -> None:
        """Apply hazard effect to robot"""
        if not robot.is_alive or not self.active:
            return
        if self.position.distance_to(robot.position) <= self.radius:
            if self.hazard_type == HazardType.LAVA:
                robot.take_damage(self.damage_per_second)
            elif self.hazard_type == HazardType.ELECTRIC_FIELD:
                robot.take_damage(self.damage_per_second * 0.5)
                robot.use_energy(5.0)
            elif self.hazard_type == HazardType.MINE_FIELD:
                if random.random() < 0.3:  # 30% chance to trigger per update
                    robot.take_damage(self.damage_per_second)
            elif self.hazard_type == HazardType.TOXIC_GAS:
                robot.take_damage(self.damage_per_second * 0.3)
                robot.use_energy(1.0)
            elif self.hazard_type == HazardType.GRAVITY_ANOMALY:
                # Slow movement and pull toward center
                direction = self.position - robot.position
                if direction.x != 0 or direction.y != 0:
                    normalized = direction.normalize()
                    robot.position.x += normalized.x * 0.5
                    robot.position.y += normalized.y * 0.5
                robot.movement_speed *= 0.5  # Slow down

@dataclass
class GameState:
    time: float = 0.0
    robots: List[Robot] = field(default_factory=list)
    objectives: List[Objective] = field(default_factory=list)
    power_ups: List[PowerUp] = field(default_factory=list)
    hazards: List[Hazard] = field(default_factory=list)
    score: Dict[Team, int] = field(default_factory=lambda: {Team.RED: 0, Team.BLUE: 0})
    team_score: Dict[Team, int] = field(default_factory=lambda: {Team.RED: 0, Team.BLUE: 0})
    match_duration: float = 600.0  # 10 minutes
    map_size: Tuple[float, float] = (500.0, 500.0)
    difficulty: float = 0.5  # 0.0 to 1.0
    round_number: int = 1
    objectives_completed: int = 0
    last_power_up_spawn: float = 0.0
    power_up_spawn_interval: float = 45.0
    
    def add_robot(self, robot: Robot) -> None:
        self.robots.append(robot)
    
    def get_team_robots(self, team: Team) -> List[Robot]:
        return [robot for robot in self.robots if robot.team == team and robot.is_alive]
    
    def get_alive_robots(self) -> List[Robot]:
        return [robot for robot in self.robots if robot.is_alive]
    
    def get_robot_by_id(self, robot_id: int) -> Optional[Robot]:
        for robot in self.robots:
            if robot.id == robot_id:
                return robot
        return None
    
    def get_nearest_objective(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[Objective]:
        """Find the nearest objective to the robot"""
        if not self.objectives:
            return None
        nearest = min(self.objectives, key=lambda obj: robot.position.distance_to(obj.position))
        return nearest if robot.position.distance_to(nearest.position) <= robot.vision_range else None
    
    def get_nearest_power_up(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[PowerUp]:
        """Find the nearest power-up to the robot"""
        if not self.power_ups:
            return None
        nearest = min(self.power_ups, key=lambda pu: robot.position.distance_to(pu.position))
        return nearest if robot.position.distance_to(nearest.position) <= robot.vision_range else None
    
    def get_nearest_enemy(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[Robot]:
        """Find the nearest enemy robot"""
        enemies = [r for r in self.robots if r.team != robot.team and r.is_alive]
        if not enemies:
            return None
        nearest = min(enemies, key=lambda e: robot.position.distance_to(e.position))
        return nearest if robot.position.distance_to(nearest.position) <= robot.vision_range else None
    
    def get_important_targets(self, robot: Robot) -> List[Dict]:
        """Get important targets for AI decision making"""
        targets = []
        
        # Add nearest enemy
        enemy = self.get_nearest_enemy(robot)
        if enemy:
            targets.append({
                'type': 'enemy',
                'robot': enemy,
                'distance': robot.position.distance_to(enemy.position),
                'priority': 3
            })
        
        # Add nearest objective
        objective = self.get_nearest_objective(robot)
        if objective and not objective.is_captured():
            targets.append({
                'type': 'objective',
                'objective': objective,
                'distance': robot.position.distance_to(objective.position),
                'priority': 4 if objective.team != robot.team else 2  # Higher priority to capture enemy objectives
            })
        
        # Add nearest power-up
        power_up = self.get_nearest_power_up(robot)
        if power_up and not power_up.collected:
            targets.append({
                'type': 'power_up',
                'power_up': power_up,
                'distance': robot.position.distance_to(power_up.position),
                'priority': 1
            })
        
        # Add teammate in need
        teammates = [r for r in self.robots if r.team == robot.team and r.is_alive and r.id != robot.id]
        for teammate in teammates:
            if teammate.health < teammate.max_health * 0.3:
                targets.append({
                    'type': 'teammate',
                    'robot': teammate,
                    'distance': robot.position.distance_to(teammate.position),
                    'priority': 5 if robot.robot_type == RobotType.SUPPORT else 1
                })
        
        # Sort by priority and return
        return sorted(targets, key=lambda x: x['priority'], reverse=True)

class AIController:
    def __init__(self, game_state: GameState):
        self.game_state = game_state
        self.last_decision_time = 0.0
        self.decision_cooldown = 0.5  # Seconds between AI decisions
        self.learning_rate = 0.1
        self.exploration_rate = 0.3  # Chance to explore new strategies
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float) -> None:
        """Update all AI robots"""
        current_time = self.game_state.time
        if current_time - self.last_decision_time < self.decision_cooldown:
            return
            
        self.last_decision_time = current_time
        self._update_ai_robots(delta_time)
    
    def _update_ai_robots(self, delta_time: float) -> None:
        """Update AI behaviors for all robots"""
        for robot in self.game_state.robots:
            if not robot.is_alive or robot.team == Team.NEUTRAL:
                continue
            
            # Update power-ups
            robot.update_power_ups(delta_time)
            
            # Update weapon cooldown
            if robot.weapon_cooldown > 0:
                robot.weapon_cooldown -= delta_time
            
            # Update robot role based on team situation
            self._assign_role(robot)
            
            # Execute AI decision
            self._make_decision(robot, delta_time)
    
    def _assign_role(self, robot: Robot) -> None:
        """Dynamically assign roles based on team composition and game state"""
        team_robots = self.game_state.get_team_robots(robot.team)
        alive_robots = [r for r in team_robots if r.is_alive]
        
        # Count roles
        roles = {
            RobotType.SCOUT: sum(1 for r in alive_robots if r.robot_type == RobotType.SCOUT),
            RobotType.SOLDIER: sum(1 for r in alive_robots if r.robot_type == RobotType.SOLDIER),
            RobotType.HEAVY: sum(1 for r in alive_robots if r.robot_type == RobotType.HEAVY),
            RobotType.SUPPORT: sum(1 for r in alive_robots if r.robot_type == RobotType.SUPPORT),
            RobotType.ENGINEER: sum(1 for r in alive_robots if r.robot_type == RobotType.ENGINEER)
        }
        
        # Default role assignment
        if roles[RobotType.SUPPORT] == 0 and robot.robot_type == RobotType.SUPPORT:
            robot.role = "support"
        elif roles[RobotType.ENGINEER] == 0 and robot.robot_type == RobotType.ENGINEER:
            robot.role = "engineer"
        elif roles[RobotType.HEAVY] == 0 and robot.robot_type == RobotType.HEAVY:
            robot.role = "heavy"
        elif robot.robot_type == RobotType.SCOUT:
            robot.role = "scout"
        else:
            robot.role = "default"
        
        # Adjust role based on current situation
        objectives = [obj for obj in self.game_state.objectives if not obj.is_captured()]
        if objectives:
            nearest_obj = self.game_state.get_nearest_objective(robot)
            if nearest_obj:
                # If objective is enemy's and we're not the only one, become attacker
                if nearest_obj.team != robot.team and len([r for r in alive_robots if r.role == "attacker"]) < len(alive_robots) // 2:
                    if robot.robot_type != RobotType.SUPPORT:
                        robot.role = "attacker"
                # If objective is our own, become defender
                elif nearest_obj.team == robot.team:
                    robot.role = "defender"
        
        # If teammates are low on health, become support if possible
        if robot.robot_type == RobotType.SUPPORT:
            low_health_teammates = [r for r in alive_robots if r.team == robot.team and r.health < r.max_health * 0.5]
            if len(low_health_teammates) > 0:
                robot.role = "support"
    
    def _make_decision(self, robot: Robot, delta_time: float) -> None:
        """AI decision-making process using adaptive strategy"""
        if not robot.is_alive:
            return
        
        # Get important targets
        targets = self.game_state.get_important_targets(robot)
        
        # Base movement
        target_pos = robot.position  # Default: stay in place
        
        # Use strategy memory to adapt to previous battles
        strategy = self._choose_strategy(robot, targets)
        
        # Execute strategy
        if strategy == "attack":
            # Attack nearest enemy
            enemy = self.game_state.get_nearest_enemy(robot)
            if enemy:
                target_pos = enemy.position
                if self._can_attack(robot, enemy):
                    self._attack(robot, enemy)
                else:
                    # Move toward enemy
                    direction = enemy.position - robot.position
                    if direction.x != 0 or direction.y != 0:
                        normalized = direction.normalize()
                        move_dist = robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time
                        robot.position.x += normalized.x * move_dist
                        robot.position.y += normalized.y * move_dist
            else:
                # No enemy in sight, move toward objective
                nearest_obj = self.game_state.get_nearest_objective(robot)
                if nearest_obj:
                    target_pos = nearest_obj.position
                    direction = nearest_obj.position - robot.position
                    if direction.x != 0 or direction.y != 0:
                        normalized = direction.normalize()
                        move_dist = robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time
                        robot.position.x += normalized.x * move_dist
                        robot.position.y += normalized.y * move_dist
        
        elif strategy == "defend":
            # Defend objective
            nearest_obj = self.game_state.get_nearest_objective(robot)
            if nearest_obj and nearest_obj.team == robot.team:
                target_pos = nearest_obj.position
                # If enemy nearby, attack
                enemy = self.game_state.get_nearest_enemy(robot)
                if enemy and self._can_attack(robot, enemy):
                    self._attack(robot, enemy)
                else:
                    # Move to objective position
                    direction = nearest_obj.position - robot.position
                    if direction.x != 0 or direction.y != 0:
                        normalized = direction.normalize()
                        move_dist = robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time
                        robot.position.x += normalized.x * move_dist
                        robot.position.y += normalized.y * move_dist
            else:
                # Default to attack if no objective to defend
                self._make_decision(robot, delta_time)
        
        elif strategy == "support":
            # Heal or buff teammate
            teammates = [r for r in self.game_state.robots if r.team == robot.team and r.is_alive and r.id != robot.id]
            if teammates:
                # Find most in need
                teammate = min(teammates, key=lambda t: t.health / t.max_health)
                if teammate.health < teammate.max_health * 0.5:
                    # Move to teammate
                    target_pos = teammate.position
                    direction = teammate.position - robot.position
                    if direction.x != 0 or direction.y != 0:
                        normalized = direction.normalize()
                        move_dist = robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time
                        robot.position.x += normalized.x * move_dist
                        robot.position.y += normalized.y * move_dist
                    # If close enough, heal
                    if robot.position.distance_to(teammate.position) < 15:
                        if robot.robot_type == RobotType.SUPPORT:
                            teammate.heal(5.0)
                            robot.use_energy(10.0)
            
        elif strategy == "engineer":
            # Engineer: repair or place defenses
            teammates = [r for r in self.game_state.robots if r.team == robot.team and r.is_alive and r.id != robot.id]
            if teammates:
                # Find most damaged teammate
                teammate = min(teammates, key=lambda t: t.health / t.max_health)
                if teammate.health < teammate.max_health * 0.7:
                    target_pos = teammate.position
                    direction = teammate.position - robot.position
                    if direction.x != 0 or direction.y != 0:
                        normalized = direction.normalize()
                        move_dist = robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time
                        robot.position.x += normalized.x * move_dist
                        robot.position.y += normalized.y * move_dist
                    # Repair if close
                    if robot.position.distance_to(teammate.position) < 15:
                        # Engineer can repair
                        heal_amount = 2.0
                        teammate.heal(heal_amount)
                        robot.use_energy(5.0)
        
        elif strategy == "scout":
            # Scout: explore and find enemies
            nearest_obj = self.game_state.get_nearest_objective(robot)
            if nearest_obj:
                target_pos = nearest_obj.position
                # Move toward objective, but with more aggressive exploration
                direction = nearest_obj.position - robot.position
                if direction.x != 0 or direction.y != 0:
                    normalized = direction.normalize()
                    move_dist = robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time * 1.2  # Scout moves faster
                    robot.position.x += normalized.x * move_dist
                    robot.position.y += normalized.y * move_dist
        
        # Move toward target if needed
        if robot.position.distance_to(target_pos) > 2.0:
            direction = target_pos - robot.position
            if direction.x != 0 or direction.y != 0:
                normalized = direction.normalize()
                move_dist = robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time
                robot.position.x += normalized.x * move_dist
                robot.position.y += normalized.y * move_dist
        
        # Clamp position to map boundaries
        map_x, map_y = self.game_state.map_size
        robot.position.x = max(0, min(map_x, robot.position.x))
        robot.position.y = max(0, min(map_y, robot.position.y))
    
    def _choose_strategy(self, robot: Robot, targets: List[Dict]) -> str:
        """Choose the best strategy based on game state and learning"""
        if not targets:
            return "patrol"
        
        # Check if we have memory of successful strategies
        if robot.strategy_memory:
            # Calculate success rate for each strategy
            strategy_success = defaultdict(list)
            for entry in robot.strategy_memory:
                strategy_success[entry['strategy']].append(entry['outcome'])
            
            # Calculate average success rate
            best_strategy = None
            best_avg = -1
            for strategy, outcomes in strategy_success.items():
                if outcomes:
                    avg_success = sum(outcomes) / len(outcomes)
                    if avg_success > best_avg:
                        best_avg = avg_success
                        best_strategy = strategy
            
            # Exploit best strategy or explore randomly
            if random.random() > self.exploration_rate and best_strategy:
                return best_strategy
        
        # Default strategy selection based on current situation
        for target in targets:
            if target['type'] == 'enemy':
                # If weapon is ready and enemy is in range, attack
                if self._can_attack(robot, target['robot']):
                    return "attack"
                # If enemy is close but weapon not ready, move closer
                elif target['distance'] < 30:
                    return "attack"
            
            elif target['type'] == 'objective':
                if target['objective'].team != robot.team:
                    # Enemy objective - capture or attack
                    if target['distance'] < 40:
                        return "attack"
                    else:
                        return "attack"
                else:
                    # Our objective - defend
                    return "defend"
            
            elif target['type'] == 'power_up':
                # Collect power-up if close
                if target['distance'] < 20:
                    return "collect_powerup"
            
            elif target['type'] == 'teammate':
                # Help teammate in need
                if target['distance'] < 30:
                    if robot.robot_type == RobotType.SUPPORT:
                        return "support"
                    elif robot.robot_type == RobotType.ENGINEER:
                        return "engineer"
        
        # Default behavior
        if robot.robot_type == RobotType.SUPPORT:
            return "support"
        elif robot.robot_type == RobotType.ENGINEER:
            return "engineer"
        elif robot.robot_type == RobotType.SCOUT:
            return "scout"
        else:
            return "attack"
    
    def _can_attack(self, robot: Robot, target: Robot) -> bool:
        """Check if robot can attack the target"""
        if not robot.is_alive or not target.is_alive:
            return False
        
        distance = robot.position.distance_to(target.position)
        
        # Weapon ranges
        weapon_ranges = {
            WeaponType.PISTOL: 40.0,
            WeaponType.RIFLE: 80.0,
            WeaponType.SHOTGUN: 20.0,
            WeaponType.SNIPER: 150.0,
            WeaponType.LAUNCHER: 60.0,
            WeaponType.MELEE: 10.0,
            WeaponType.EMP: 50.0
        }
        
        range_limit = weapon_ranges.get(robot.weapon, 40.0)
        
        # Check if target is in range
        if distance > range_limit:
            return False
        
        # Check cooldown
        if robot.weapon_cooldown > 0:
            return False
        
        # Check ammo (if applicable)
        if robot.weapon != WeaponType.MELEE and robot.weapon != WeaponType.EMP:
            if robot.weapon_ammo <= 0:
                return False
        
        # EMP has special conditions
        if robot.weapon == WeaponType.EMP:
            # EMP works on any robot in range, but has cooldown
            return True
        
        return True
    
    def _attack(self, robot: Robot, target: Robot) -> None:
        """Execute attack on target"""
        if not self._can_attack(robot, target):
            return
        
        # Calculate damage based on weapon and difficulty
        base_damage = {
            WeaponType.PISTOL: 10,
            WeaponType.RIFLE: 15,
            WeaponType.SHOTGUN: 30,
            WeaponType.SNIPER: 50,
            WeaponType.LAUNCHER: 40,
            WeaponType.MELEE: 25,
            WeaponType.EMP: 0  # EMP doesn't deal damage, it disables
        }
        
        damage = base_damage.get(robot.weapon, 10)
        
        # Apply difficulty multiplier
        damage *= (0.8 + self.game_state.difficulty * 0.4)
        
        # Apply power-up effects
        if PowerUpType.SUPER_WEAPON in robot.power_ups:
            damage *= 2.0
        
        # Special handling for EMP
        if robot.weapon == WeaponType.EMP:
            target.weapon_cooldown = 5.0  # Disable for 5 seconds
            logger.info(f"Robot {robot.id} used EMP on Robot {target.id}!")
            robot.use_energy(20.0)
        else:
            # Regular attack
            target.take_damage(damage)
            
            # Reduce ammo
            if robot.weapon != WeaponType.MELEE:
                robot.weapon_ammo -= 1
                if robot.weapon_ammo <= 0:
                    # Recharge ammo
                    robot.weapon_ammo = robot.max_ammo
                    logger.info(f"Robot {robot.id} reloaded!")
            
            # Reset cooldown
            cooldowns = {
                WeaponType.PISTOL: 0.2,
                WeaponType.RIFLE: 0.4,
                WeaponType.SHOTGUN: 0.8,
                WeaponType.SNIPER: 1.5,
                WeaponType.LAUNCHER: 2.0,
                WeaponType.MELEE: 1.0,
                WeaponType.EMP: 10.0
            }
            
            robot.weapon_cooldown = cooldowns.get(robot.weapon, 0.5)
            
            # Reward for successful hit
            if target.health > 0:
                self._update_strategy_memory(robot, "attack", 0.7)
            else:
                self._update_strategy_memory(robot, "attack", 1.0)
        
        # Play sound effect (simulated)
        logger.info(f"Robot {robot.id} attacked Robot {target.id} with {robot.weapon.value} for {damage} damage!")
    
    def _update_strategy_memory(self, robot: Robot, strategy: str, outcome: float) -> None:
        """Update strategy memory with outcome (0.0 to 1.0)"""
        if len(robot.strategy_memory) > 10:  # Limit memory size
            robot.strategy_memory.pop(0)
        
        robot.strategy_memory.append({
            'strategy': strategy,
            'outcome': outcome,
            'timestamp': self.game_state.time
        })

@dataclass
class Position:
    x: float
    y: float

    def distance_to(self, other: 'Position') -> float:
        return math.sqrt((self.x - other.x) ** 2 + (self.y - other.y) ** 2)

    def __add__(self, other: 'Position') -> 'Position':
        return Position(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)

    def __sub__(self, other: 'Position') -> 'Position':
        return Position(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)

    def normalize(self) -> 'Position':
        mag = math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
        if mag == 0:
            return Position(0, 0)
        return Position(self.x / mag, self.y / mag)

            return health_factor * 2 + distance_factor + threat_factor

        return max(visible_enemies, key=target_score)

    def get_objective_target(self, objectives: List['Objective']) -> Optional['Objective']:
        """Find the closest or most valuable objective based on role."""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return None

        relevant_objectives = [obj for obj in objectives if obj.is_active]
        if not relevant_objectives:
            return None

        # Role-based objective preference
        role_priority = {
            RobotRole.ATTACKER: [ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE, ObjectiveType.ESCORT_PAYLOAD],
            RobotRole.DEFENDER: [ObjectiveType.BASE_DEFENSE],
            RobotRole.SUPPORT: [ObjectiveType.ESCORT_PAYLOAD, ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE],
            RobotRole.SCOUT: [ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE, ObjectiveType.ESCORT_PAYLOAD],
            RobotRole.JUGGERNAUT: [ObjectiveType.BASE_DEFENSE, ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE]
        }

        # Filter by role priority
        preferred_types = role_priority.get(self.role, [obj.type for obj in relevant_objectives])
        preferred = [obj for obj in relevant_objectives if obj.type in preferred_types]
        if preferred:
            relevant_objectives = preferred

        # Choose closest
        return min(relevant_objectives, key=lambda obj: self.position.distance_to(obj.position))

    def get_move_direction(self, robots: List['Robot'], objectives: List['Objective'], team: int) -> Position:
        """Calculate movement direction based on AI strategy and current state."""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return Position(0, 0)

        # Target detection
        target = self.get_best_target(robots, team)
        objective = self.get_objective_target(objectives)

        # AI complexity affects decision-making depth
        complexity = self.ai_complexity

        # If we have a target, prioritize engaging
        if target and random.random() < complexity:
            # Move toward target
            direction = (target.position - self.position).normalize()
            return direction

        # If we have an objective and it's relevant, move toward it
        if objective and random.random() < complexity * 0.8:
            direction = (objective.position - self.position).normalize()
            return direction

        # Patrol behavior if no immediate targets
        # Use simple pattern: circular movement or random wander
        if random.random() < 0.3:  # 30% chance to change direction
            angle = random.uniform(0, 2 * math.pi)
            return Position(math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle))
        
        # Continue previous direction (momentum)
        return Position(0, 0)  # Placeholder - in real implementation, track last direction

    def perform_action(self, robots: List['Robot'], objectives: List['Objective'], team: int, delta_time: float) -> str:
        """Perform a combat or support action based on current state and AI complexity."""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return "dead"

        # Update cooldowns and power-ups
        self.update_cooldowns(delta_time)
        self.update_power_ups(delta_time)

        # Determine action based on role and situation
        target = self.get_best_target(robots, team)
        objective = self.get_objective_target(objectives)

        action = "patrol"
        action_type = "none"

        # Support role: heal allies or provide buffs
        if self.role == RobotRole.SUPPORT:
            # Find allies with low health
            allies = [r for r in robots if r.team == team and r.is_alive and r.health < r.max_health * 0.7]
            if allies and self.cooldowns['ability'] <= 0:
                closest_allie = min(allies, key=lambda r: self.position.distance_to(r.position))
                # Use support ability
                closest_allie.heal(15)
                self.cooldowns['ability'] = 5.0  # 5 second cooldown
                action = "heal"
                action_type = "support"
                self.teamwork_score += 0.5
                return action

        # Attack role: engage enemy
        if target and self.weapon.type == WeaponType.RANGED and self.cooldowns['reload'] <= 0:
            # Ranged attack
            if random.random() < self.ai_complexity:
                self.weapon.fire(self, target)
                self.cooldowns['reload'] = self.weapon.fire_rate
                action = "shoot"
                action_type = "ranged"
                self.teamwork_score += 0.3
                return action

        if target and self.weapon.type == WeaponType.MELEE:
            # Melee attack
            if self.position.distance_to(target.position) < self.weapon.range:
                self.weapon.fire(self, target)
                action = "melee"
                action_type = "melee"
                self.teamwork_score += 0.4
                return action

        # If we have an objective and we're close enough, interact
        if objective and self.position.distance_to(objective.position) < 3.0:
            objective.interact(self)
            action = f"interact_{objective.type.value}"
            return action

        # Default action: move toward target or objective
        return action

@dataclass
class Weapon:
    type: WeaponType
    damage: float
    range: float
    fire_rate: float  # seconds between shots
    ammo: int  # -1 for unlimited
    current_ammo: int = field(init=False)
    reload_time: float = 2.0  # seconds to reload
    is_reloading: bool = False

    def __post_init__(self):
        self.current_ammo = self.ammo

    def fire(self, shooter: Robot, target: Robot) -> bool:
        """Fire weapon at target. Returns True if hit."""
        if not shooter.is_alive or not target.is_alive:
            return False

        # Check if in range
        if shooter.position.distance_to(target.position) > self.range:
            return False

        # Check ammo if limited
        if self.ammo != -1:
            if self.current_ammo <= 0:
                self.is_reloading = True
                return False
            self.current_ammo -= 1

        # Apply damage
        target.take_damage(self.damage)
        
        # Add visual/sound effects (in real system: trigger event)
        # In simulation, we just log
        # For this implementation, we'll assume it hits
        return True

    def reload(self):
        if self.ammo != -1:
            self.current_ammo = self.ammo
            self.is_reloading = False

@dataclass
class Objective:
    id: int
    type: ObjectiveType
    position: Position
    team: Optional[int] = None  # Which team controls it, None if neutral
    progress: float = 0.0  # 0.0 to 1.0
    is_active: bool = True
    capture_radius: float = 5.0
    capture_time: float = 10.0  # seconds to capture
    defenders: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)  # Robot IDs defending
    payload_speed: float = 0.5  # For escort objectives
    payload_destination: Optional[Position] = None

    def interact(self, robot: Robot) -> bool:
        """Robot interacts with objective"""
        if not self.is_active:
            return False

        distance = robot.position.distance_to(self.position)
        if distance > self.capture_radius:
            return False

        # Capture logic
        if self.type == ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE:
            if self.team is None or self.team == robot.team:
                # In progress of capture
                self.progress += (1.0 / self.capture_time) * (1.0 if self.team == robot.team else 0.5)
                if self.team != robot.team:
                    self.defenders.append(robot.id)
                    self.defenders = list(set(self.defenders))  # Remove duplicates
                if self.progress >= 1.0:
                    self.team = robot.team
                    self.progress = 1.0
                    return True  # Captured!
            else:
                # Enemy is trying to capture, reduce progress
                self.progress -= 0.02
                if self.progress <= 0:
                    self.team = None
                    self.progress = 0
        elif self.type == ObjectiveType.ESCORT_PAYLOAD:
            # Robot pushes payload
            if self.team == robot.team:
                self.progress += 0.1
                if self.progress >= 1.0 and self.payload_destination:
                    # Payload reached destination
                    self.is_active = False
                    return True
        elif self.type == ObjectiveType.BASE_DEFENSE:
            # Base is being defended
            self.defenders.append(robot.id)
            self.defenders = list(set(self.defenders))
            self.progress += 0.05
            if self.progress >= 1.0:
                self.progress = 1.0
                return True

        return False

@dataclass
class PowerUp:

@dataclass
class Hazard:

@dataclass
class GameState:
    robots: List[Robot]
    objectives: List[Objective]
    power_ups: List[PowerUp]
    hazards: List[Hazard]
    team_scores: Dict[int, int] = field(default_factory=lambda: {0: 0, 1: 0})
    team_objectives: Dict[int, int] = field(default_factory=lambda: {0: 0, 1: 0})  # Completed objectives per team
    time_elapsed: float = 0.0
    round_active: bool = True
    winner: Optional[int] = None
    game_stats: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)  # For analytics
    ai_complexity: float = BASE_AI_COMPLEXITY

    def get_team_robots(self, team: int) -> List[Robot]:
        return [r for r in self.robots if r.team == team]

    def get_alive_robots(self) -> List[Robot]:
        return [r for r in self.robots if r.is_alive]

    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        """Update the entire game state."""
        self.time_elapsed += delta_time

        # Update robots
        for robot in self.robots:
            if not robot.is_alive:
                continue
            robot.update_cooldowns(delta_time)
            robot.update_power_ups(delta_time)

            # Check for hazard damage
            for hazard in self.hazards:
                if hazard.active and hazard.position.distance_to(robot.position) < hazard.radius:
                    robot.take_damage(hazard.damage * delta_time)
                    # Trigger effect

        # Update objectives
        for obj in self.objectives:
            if not obj.is_active:
                continue
            # Auto-advance escort objectives
            if obj.type == ObjectiveType.ESCORT_PAYLOAD and obj.team is not None:
                # Move payload toward destination if not yet reached
                if obj.progress < 1.0 and obj.payload_destination:
                    # Move slightly toward destination based on team's progress
                    direction = (obj.payload_destination - obj.position).normalize()
                    if direction.x != 0 or direction.y != 0:
                        obj.position = obj.position + direction * (obj.payload_speed * delta_time)
                        # Update progress based on distance traveled
                        total_distance = obj.position.distance_to(obj.payload_destination)
                        initial_distance = obj.initial_distance
                        if initial_distance > 0:
                            obj.progress = 1.0 - (total_distance / initial_distance)
                            obj.progress = min(1.0, max(0.0, obj.progress))

        # Update power-ups
        for power_up in self.power_ups:
            if power_up.is_active:
                power_up.spawn_time += delta_time
                # Auto-despawn after a while
                if power_up.spawn_time > 30.0:  # 30 seconds max
                    power_up.is_active = False

        # Check for objective completions
        for obj in self.objectives:
            if obj.is_active and obj.progress >= 1.0:
                # Objective completed
                if obj.type == ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE:
                    self.team_objectives[obj.team] += 1
                    self.team_scores[obj.team] += SCORE_OBJECTIVE_COMPLETE
                    obj.is_active = False
                    # Play sound effect
                elif obj.type == ObjectiveType.ESCORT_PAYLOAD:
                    self.team_objectives[obj.team] += 1
                    self.team_scores[obj.team] += SCORE_OBJECTIVE_COMPLETE
                    obj.is_active = False
                elif obj.type == ObjectiveType.BASE_DEFENSE:
                    self.team_objectives[obj.team] += 1
                    self.team_scores[obj.team] += SCORE_OBJECTIVE_COMPLETE
                    obj.is_active = False

        # Check if all objectives are complete
        if sum(self.team_objectives.values()) >= MAX_OBJECTIVES:
            # Game ends
            self.round_active = False
            if self.team_scores[0] > self.team_scores[1]:
                self.winner = 0
            elif self.team_scores[1] > self.team_scores[0]:
                self.winner = 1
            else:
                self.winner = None  # Tie

        # Update AI complexity based on team performance
        self.adapt_ai_difficulty()

    def adapt_ai_difficulty(self):
        """Adapt AI complexity based on team performance."""
        # Calculate average team performance
        team_1_robots = self.get_team_robots(0)
        team_2_robots = self.get_team_robots(1)
        
        avg_team_1_performance = sum(r.teamwork_score for r in team_1_robots) / len(team_1_robots) if team_1_robots else 0
        avg_team_2_performance = sum(r.teamwork_score for r in team_2_robots) / len(team_2_robots) if team_2_robots else 0
        
        # Calculate overall performance imbalance
        performance_diff = abs(avg_team_1_performance - avg_team_2_performance)
        
        # Increase AI complexity if one team is dominating
        if performance_diff > 0.5:
            # Boost AI for the weaker team
            if avg_team_1_performance < avg_team_2_performance:
                for robot in team_1_robots:
                    robot.ai_complexity = min(MAX_AI_COMPLEXITY, robot.ai_complexity + AI_ADAPTATION_RATE)
            else:
                for robot in team_2_robots:
                    robot.ai_complexity = min(MAX_AI_COMPLEXITY, robot.ai_complexity + AI_ADAPTATION_RATE)
        else:
            # Slightly reduce complexity if teams are balanced
            for robot in self.robots:
                robot.ai_complexity = max(MIN_AI_COMPLEXITY, robot.ai_complexity - AI_ADAPTATION_RATE * 0.2)

    def spawn_power_up(self):
        """Spawn a random power-up at a random location."""
        if random.random() < POWER_UP_SPAWN_RATE and len([p for p in self.power_ups if p.is_active]) < 5:
            x = random.uniform(5, MAP_SIZE[0] - 5)
            y = random.uniform(5, MAP_SIZE[1] - 5)
            power_type = random.choice(list(PowerUpType))
            self.power_ups.append(PowerUp(power_type, Position(x, y)))

    def spawn_hazards(self):
        """Generate environmental hazards."""
        if len(self.hazards) < int(MAP_SIZE[0] * MAP_SIZE[1] * Hazard_DENSITY):
            for _ in range(int(MAP_SIZE[0] * MAP_SIZE[1] * Hazard_DENSITY) - len(self.hazards)):
                x = random.uniform(0, MAP_SIZE[0])
                y = random.uniform(0, MAP_SIZE[1])
                hazard_type = random.choice(list(HazardType))
                self.hazards.append(Hazard(hazard_type, Position(x, y), damage=random.uniform(0.5, 2.0)))

    def check_power_up_pickup(self, robot: Robot):
        """Check if robot is near a power-up and pick it up."""
        for power_up in self.power_ups:
            if not power_up.is_active:
                continue
            if robot.position.distance_to(power_up.position) < 2.0:
                robot.apply_power_up(power_up.type, power_up.duration)
                power_up.is_active = False
                # Play sound effect

    def get_game_summary(self) -> Dict:
        """Return a summary of the game state for debugging/analysis."""
        return {
            "time_elapsed": self.time_elapsed,
            "round_active": self.round_active,
            "winner": self.winner,
            "team_scores": self.team_scores,
            "team_objectives": self.team_objectives,
            "alive_robots": len(self.get_alive_robots()),
            "ai_complexity": self.ai_complexity,
            "robot_stats": [
                {
                    "id": r.id,

                    "alive": r.is_alive
                } for r in self.robots

class CyberArena:
    def __init__(self):
        self.state = GameState(
            robots=[],
            objectives=[],
            power_ups=[],
            hazards=[],
            team_scores={0: 0, 1: 0},
            team_objectives={0: 0, 1: 0},
            time_elapsed=0.0,
            round_active=True,
            winner=None,
            game_stats={},
            ai_complexity=BASE_AI_COMPLEXITY
        )
        self.last_tick = time.time()
        self.paused = False
        self.is_running = False
        self.thread = None

    def initialize_game(self):
        """Initialize game with robots, objectives, power-ups, and hazards."""
        # Create robots
        robots = []
        for team in range(TEAM_COUNT):
            for i in range(ROBOTS_PER_TEAM):
                robot_id = team * ROBOTS_PER_TEAM + i
                # Assign roles in a balanced way
                role = RobotRole(list(RobotRole)[i % len(RobotRole)])
                
                # Spawn position: distribute around team base
                base_x = 20 if team == 0 else 80
                base_y = 50
                offset_x = random.uniform(-8, 8)
                offset_y = random.uniform(-8, 8)
                pos = Position(base_x + offset_x, base_y + offset_y)
                
                robots.append(Robot(
                    id=robot_id,
                    team=team,
                    role=role,
                    position=pos
                ))
        
        # Create objectives
        objectives = []
        objective_types = [ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE, ObjectiveType.BASE_DEFENSE, ObjectiveType.ESCORT_PAYLOAD]
        
        for i, obj_type in enumerate(objective_types):
            x = random.uniform(30, 70)
            y = random.uniform(30, 70)
            pos = Position(x, y)
            
            obj = Objective(
                id=i,
                type=obj_type,
                position=pos
            )
            
            if obj_type == ObjectiveType.ESCORT_PAYLOAD:
                # Set destination for escort
                dest_x = random.uniform(30, 70)
                dest_y = random.uniform(30, 70)
                while pos.distance_to(Position(dest_x, dest_y)) < 15:
                    dest_x = random.uniform(30, 70)
                    dest_y = random.uniform(30, 70)
                obj.payload_destination = Position(dest_x, dest_y)
                obj.initial_distance = pos.distance_to(obj.payload_destination)
            
            objectives.append(obj)
        
        # Create hazards
        hazards = []
        for _ in range(int(MAP_SIZE[0] * MAP_SIZE[1] * Hazard_DENSITY)):
            x = random.uniform(0, MAP_SIZE[0])
            y = random.uniform(0, MAP_SIZE[1])
            hazard_type = random.choice(list(HazardType))
            hazards.append(Hazard(hazard_type, Position(x, y), damage=random.uniform(0.5, 2.0)))
        
        # Initialize power-ups list
        power_ups = []
        
        # Set initial game state
        self.state = GameState(
            robots=robots,
            objectives=objectives,
            power_ups=power_ups,
            hazards=hazards,
            team_scores={0: 0, 1: 0},
            team_objectives={0: 0, 1: 0},
            time_elapsed=0.0,
            round_active=True,
            winner=None,
            game_stats={},
            ai_complexity=BASE_AI_COMPLEXITY
        )
        
        print("CyberArena initialized with", len(robots), "robots and", len(objectives), "objectives.")
        
    def update(self, delta_time: float) -> bool:
        """Update game state for one tick."""
        if not self.state.round_active:
            return False

        # Spawn power-ups and hazards occasionally
        self.state.spawn_power_up()
        self.state.spawn_hazards()

        # Update each robot's behavior
        for robot in self.state.robots:
            if not robot.is_alive:
                continue

            # Check for power-up pickup
            self.state.check_power_up_pickup(robot)

            # Perform AI action
            action = robot.perform_action(self.state.robots, self.state.objectives, robot.team, delta_time)
            
            # Update movement
            if action != "dead":
                direction = robot.get_move_direction(self.state.robots, self.state.objectives, robot.team)
                if direction.x != 0 or direction.y != 0:
                    new_pos = robot.position + direction * (robot.speed * delta_time)
                    # Boundary check
                    new_pos.x = max(0, min(MAP_SIZE[0], new_pos.x))
                    new_pos.y = max(0, min(MAP_SIZE[1], new_pos.y))
                    robot.position = new_pos

        # Update game state
        self.state.update(delta_time)

        # Log state for debugging
        if self.state.time_elapsed % 10 < delta_time:  # Every 10 seconds
            summary = self.state.get_game_summary()
            print(f"Time: {self.state.time_elapsed:.1f}s | Team 0: {summary['team_scores'][0]} | Team 1: {summary['team_scores'][1]} | Alive: {summary['alive_robots']}")

        return True

    def run(self):
        """Start the game loop."""
        self.is_running = True
        self.last_tick = time.time()
        
        while self.is_running:
            current_time = time.time()
            delta_time = current_time - self.last_tick
            self.last_tick = current_time
            
            # Cap delta_time to avoid large jumps
            delta_time = min(delta_time, 1.0 / GAME_TICK_RATE)
            
            # Only update if game is active
            if not self.paused:
                if not self.update(delta_time):
                    break  # Game ended
            
            time.sleep(max(0, (1.0 / GAME_TICK_RATE) - (time.time() - current_time)))

    def pause(self):
        self.paused = not self.paused

    def stop(self):
        self.is_running = False

    def get_state(self) -> GameState:
        return self.state
