    round_number: int = 1
    max_rounds: int = MAX_BATTLES
    team_scores: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=lambda: {team: 0 for team in TEAM_COLORS})
    last_power_up_spawn: float = 0.0
    last_hazard_spawn: float = 0.0
    power_up_spawn_interval: float = 20.0
    hazard_spawn_interval: float = 45.0
    difficulty_level: float = 1.0  # 1.0 = normal, higher = harder
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        # Initialize with default objectives
        self.add_objective(ObjectiveType.CAPTURE_FLAG, Vector2D(200, 400), TEAM_COLORS[0])
        self.add_objective(ObjectiveType.CAPTURE_FLAG, Vector2D(800, 400), TEAM_COLORS[1])
        
        # Initialize with some hazards
        self.add_hazard(HazardType.ELECTRIC_FIELD, Vector2D(500, 300), 40, 2.0)
        self.add_hazard(HazardType.TOXIC_GAS, Vector2D(500, 500), 50, 1.5)
    
    def add_robot(self, robot: Robot):
        """Add a robot to the arena."""
        self.robots.append(robot)
    
    def add_objective(self, objective_type: ObjectiveType, position: Vector2D, team_required: str):
        """Add an objective to the arena."""
        objective = Objective(objective_type, position, team_required)
        self.objectives.append(objective)
    
    def add_hazard(self, hazard_type: HazardType, position: Vector2D, radius: float, damage_per_second: float):
        """Add a hazard to the arena."""
        hazard = Hazard(hazard_type, position, radius, damage_per_second)
        self.hazards.append(hazard)
    
    def add_power_up(self, power_up_type: PowerUpType, position: Vector2D, value: float):
        """Add a power-up to the arena."""
        power_up = PowerUp(power_up_type, position, value)
        self.power_ups.append(power_up)
    
    def spawn_random_power_up(self):
        """Spawn a random power-up at a random location."""
        if time.time() - self.last_power_up_spawn < self.power_up_spawn_interval:
            return
            
        x = random.randint(100, WORLD_WIDTH - 100)
        y = random.randint(100, WORLD_HEIGHT - 100)
        power_up_type = random.choice(list(PowerUpType))
        value = random.uniform(15, 40)
        self.add_power_up(power_up_type, Vector2D(x, y), value)
        self.last_power_up_spawn = time.time()
        
    def spawn_random_hazard(self):
        """Spawn a random hazard at a random location."""
        if time.time() - self.last_hazard_spawn < self.hazard_spawn_interval:
            return
            
        x = random.randint(100, WORLD_WIDTH - 100)
        y = random.randint(100, WORLD_HEIGHT - 100)
        hazard_type = random.choice(list(HazardType))
        radius = random.randint(30, 70)
        damage_per_second = random.uniform(1.0, 3.0)
        self.add_hazard(hazard_type, Vector2D(x, y), radius, damage_per_second)
        self.last_hazard_spawn = time.time()
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        """Update the entire arena state."""
        if self.game_state != GameState.RUNNING:
            return
            
        self.time += delta_time
        
        # Update robots
        for robot in self.robots:
            robot.update(delta_time)
        
        # Update projectiles
        self.projectiles = [p for p in self.projectiles if p.update(delta_time)]
        
        # Update objectives
        for objective in self.objectives:
            objective.update(self.robots, delta_time)
            
        # Update hazards
        for hazard in self.hazards[:]:
            if not hazard.update(delta_time):
                self.hazards.remove(hazard)
            else:
                hazard.affect_robots(self.robots)
                
        # Update power-ups
        for power_up in self.power_ups[:]:
            if not power_up.active:
                self.power_ups.remove(power_up)
                
        # Spawn new power-ups and hazards periodically
        self.spawn_random_power_up()
        self.spawn_random_hazard()
        
        # Check for collisions between projectiles and robots
        self.check_projectile_collisions()
        
        # Check for power-up pickups
        self.check_power_up_pickups()
        
        # Check for round completion
        self.check_round_completion()
        
        # Adjust difficulty based on performance
        self.adjust_difficulty()
    
    def check_projectile_collisions(self):
        """Check for collisions between projectiles and robots."""
        for projectile in self.projectiles[:]:
            for robot in self.robots:
                if robot.is_alive and robot.team != projectile.source.team:
                    if projectile.check_collision(robot):
                        # Apply damage to robot
                        robot.take_damage(projectile.damage, projectile.weapon_name)
                        
                        # Add score for the source robot
                        projectile.source.score += 10
                        
                        # Add team contribution
                        projectile.source.team_contributions[robot.team] = projectile.source.team_contributions.get(robot.team, 0) + 1
                        
                        # Add team score for killing opponent
                        if not robot.is_alive:
                            projectile.source.team_contributions[robot.team] += 50
                            projectile.source.score += 50
                            self.team_scores[projectile.source.team] += 50
                        
                        # Add special effect for kill
                        if not robot.is_alive:
                            # Create visual effect (not implemented in this text-based version)
                            pass
                            
                        # Remove projectile after hit
                        self.projectiles.remove(projectile)
                        break
    
    def check_power_up_pickups(self):
        """Check for robots picking up power-ups."""
        for robot in self.robots:
            if not robot.is_alive:
                continue
                
            for power_up in self.power_ups[:]:
                if power_up.active and robot.position.distance_to(power_up.position) <= 40:
                    # Apply power-up effect
                    power_up.apply(robot)
                    
                    # Add score for power-up pickup
                    robot.score += 15
                    self.team_scores[robot.team] += 15
                    robot.team_contributions["power_ups"] = robot.team_contributions.get("power_ups", 0) + 1
                    
                    # Remove power-up after pickup
                    self.power_ups.remove(power_up)
                    
                    # Add audio feedback (not implemented here)
                    break
    
    def check_round_completion(self):
        """Check if the current round should end."""
        # Check if all robots from one team are eliminated
        team_1_alive = sum(1 for r in self.robots if r.team == TEAM_COLORS[0] and r.is_alive)
        team_2_alive = sum(1 for r in self.robots if r.team == TEAM_COLORS[1] and r.is_alive)
        
        if team_1_alive == 0 or team_2_alive == 0:
            # Round ends when one team is eliminated
            winner = TEAM_COLORS[0] if team_2_alive == 0 else TEAM_COLORS[1]
            self.team_scores[winner] += 100  # Bonus for winning round
            self.game_state = GameState.ENDED
            
            # Add objective-based rewards
            for objective in self.objectives:
                if objective.is_complete and objective.captured_by:
                    self.team_scores[objective.captured_by] += 30
            
            return
        
        # Check if all objectives are completed
        completed_objectives = sum(1 for o in self.objectives if o.is_complete)
        if completed_objectives == len(self.objectives):
            # Find which team has more objectives captured
            team1_objectives = sum(1 for o in self.objectives if o.captured_by == TEAM_COLORS[0])
            team2_objectives = sum(1 for o in self.objectives if o.captured_by == TEAM_COLORS[1])
            
            if team1_objectives > team2_objectives:
                winner = TEAM_COLORS[0]
            elif team2_objectives > team1_objectives:
                winner = TEAM_COLORS[1]
            else:
                # Tie - no winner
                return
                
            self.team_scores[winner] += 100
            self.game_state = GameState.ENDED
            return
        
        # Check if timeout reached (2 minutes)
        if self.time >= 120.0:
            # Determine winner by score
            if self.team_scores[TEAM_COLORS[0]] > self.team_scores[TEAM_COLORS[1]]:
                winner = TEAM_COLORS[0]
            elif self.team_scores[TEAM_COLORS[1]] > self.team_scores[TEAM_COLORS[0]]:
                winner = TEAM_COLORS[1]
            else:
                winner = None  # Tie
            
            if winner:
                self.team_scores[winner] += 50  # Bonus for winning by score
            self.game_state = GameState.ENDED
    
    def adjust_difficulty(self):
        """Adjust AI difficulty based on team performance."""
        team1_score = self.team_scores[TEAM_COLORS[0]]
        team2_score = self.team_scores[TEAM_COLORS[1]]
        
        # Increase difficulty if one team is dominating
        if abs(team1_score - team2_score) > 150:
            # Make the weaker team's AI more aggressive
            if team1_score > team2_score:
                self.difficulty_level = 1.2  # Increase difficulty for team 1
            else:
                self.difficulty_level = 1.2  # Increase difficulty for team 2
        else:
            # Reset to normal difficulty
            self.difficulty_level = 1.0
        
        # Adjust AI behavior based on difficulty level
        for robot in self.robots:
            if robot.is_alive:
                # Increase AI aggression and accuracy with difficulty
                if robot.role == "attacker":
                    robot.strategy = "aggressive" if self.difficulty_level > 1.0 else "balanced"
                elif robot.role == "defender":
                    robot.strategy = "defensive" if self.difficulty_level > 1.0 else "balanced"
    
    def get_game_state_summary(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:

        return {
            "time": self.time,

            "robots_alive": {
                TEAM_COLORS[0]: sum(1 for r in self.robots if r.team == TEAM_COLORS[0] and r.is_alive),
                TEAM_COLORS[1]: sum(1 for r in self.robots if r.team == TEAM_COLORS[1] and r.is_alive)
            },
            "objectives_completed": sum(1 for o in self.objectives if o.is_complete),

class AIController(ABC):
    """Abstract base class for AI controllers."""
    
    def __init__(self, robot: Robot, arena: Arena):
        self.robot = robot
        self.arena = arena
        self.ai_memory: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        self.last_decision_time = 0.0
        self.decision_interval = 0.5  # seconds between AI decisions
        
    @abstractmethod
    def make_decision(self, delta_time: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Make an AI decision based on current state."""
        pass
    
    def get_nearest_enemy(self) -> Optional[Robot]:
        """Get the nearest enemy robot."""
        enemies = self.robot.get_perceived_enemies(self.arena.robots)
        if not enemies:
            return None
        return min(enemies, key=lambda e: self.robot.position.distance_to(e.position))
    
    def get_nearest_allied_robot(self) -> Optional[Robot]:
        """Get the nearest allied robot."""
        allies = self.robot.get_perceived_allies(self.arena.robots)
        if not allies:
            return None
        return min(allies, key=lambda a: self.robot.position.distance_to(a.position))
    
    def get_nearest_power_up(self) -> Optional[PowerUp]:
        """Get the nearest power-up."""
        if not self.arena.power_ups:
            return None
        return min(self.arena.power_ups, key=lambda p: self.robot.position.distance_to(p.position))
    
    def get_nearest_objective(self) -> Optional[Objective]:
        """Get the nearest objective for this robot's team."""
        objectives = [o for o in self.arena.objectives if o.team_required == self.robot.team]
        if not objectives:
            return None
        return min(objectives, key=lambda o: self.robot.position.distance_to(o.position))
    
    def get_nearest_hazard(self) -> Optional[Hazard]:
        """Get the nearest hazard."""
        if not self.arena.hazards:
            return None
        return min(self.arena.hazards, key=lambda h: self.robot.position.distance_to(h.position))
    
    def calculate_path_to(self, target: Vector2D) -> Vector2D:
        """Calculate a direction vector toward target."""
        direction = (target - self.robot.position).normalize()
        return direction

class AggressiveAI(AIController):
    """Aggressive AI that prioritizes attacking enemies."""
    
    def make_decision(self, delta_time: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        if time.time() - self.last_decision_time < self.decision_interval:
            return {"action": "idle"}
            
        self.last_decision_time = time.time()
        
        # Check if robot is dead or has no weapon
        if not self.robot.is_alive or not self.robot.weapon:
            return {"action": "idle"}
        
        # Get nearest enemy
        enemy = self.get_nearest_enemy()
        if enemy and self.robot.weapon.can_fire(self.robot):
            # Calculate direction to enemy
            direction = self.calculate_path_to(enemy.position)
            
            # If enemy is in range, fire
            if self.robot.position.distance_to(enemy.position) <= self.robot.weapon.range:
                return {
                    "action": "fire",
                    "target": enemy.position
                }
            else:
                # Move toward enemy
                return {
                    "action": "move",
                    "direction": direction
                }
        
        # If no enemy in range, try to find power-up
        power_up = self.get_nearest_power_up()
        if power_up and power_up.active:
            if self.robot.position.distance_to(power_up.position) < 150:
                return {
                    "action": "move",
                    "direction": self.calculate_path_to(power_up.position)
                }
        
        # Otherwise, patrol or find objectives
        objective = self.get_nearest_objective()
        if objective and objective.captured_by != self.robot.team:
            return {
                "action": "move",
                "direction": self.calculate_path_to(objective.position)
            }
        
        # Default: move randomly
        return {
            "action": "move",
            "direction": Vector2D(random.uniform(-1, 1), random.uniform(-1, 1)).normalize()
        }

class DefensiveAI(AIController):
    """Defensive AI that prioritizes protecting objectives and allies."""
    
    def make_decision(self, delta_time: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        if time.time() - self.last_decision_time < self.decision_interval:
            return {"action": "idle"}
            
        self.last_decision_time = time.time()
        
        if not self.robot.is_alive or not self.robot.weapon:
            return {"action": "idle"}
        
        # Check if a teammate is under attack
        enemies = self.robot.get_perceived_enemies(self.arena.robots)
        allies = self.robot.get_perceived_allies(self.arena.robots)
        
        # Prioritize protecting objectives
        objective = self.get_nearest_objective()
        if objective:
            if objective.captured_by == self.robot.team:
                # Defend our captured objective
                if self.robot.position.distance_to(objective.position) > 100:
                    return {
                        "action": "move",
                        "direction": self.calculate_path_to(objective.position)
                    }
                # If enemy is near objective, attack
                for enemy in enemies:
                    if enemy.position.distance_to(objective.position) < 150:
                        if self.robot.weapon.can_fire(self.robot):
                            return {
                                "action": "fire",
                                "target": enemy.position
                            }
                        else:
                            return {
                                "action": "move",
                                "direction": self.calculate_path_to(enemy.position)
                            }
            else:
                # Try to capture enemy objective
                if self.robot.position.distance_to(objective.position) > 100:
                    return {
                        "action": "move",
                        "direction": self.calculate_path_to(objective.position)
                    }
        
        # Protect nearest ally under threat
        for ally in allies:
            for enemy in enemies:
                if ally.position.distance_to(enemy.position) < 100:
                    # Ally is threatened, move to protect
                    if self.robot.weapon.can_fire(self.robot):
                        return {
                            "action": "fire",
                            "target": enemy.position
                        }
                    else:
                        return {
                            "action": "move",
                            "direction": self.calculate_path_to(ally.position)
                        }
        
        # If no immediate threats, patrol around objective
        if objective:
            # Move in a circular pattern around objective
            angle = (self.robot.id * 0.1 + self.arena.time) % (2 * math.pi)
            offset = Vector2D(
                math.cos(angle) * 80,
                math.sin(angle) * 80
            )
            patrol_point = objective.position + offset
            return {
                "action": "move",
                "direction": self.calculate_path_to(patrol_point)
            }
        
        # Default: move to nearest power-up
        power_up = self.get_nearest_power_up()
        if power_up and power_up.active:
            return {
                "action": "move",
                "direction": self.calculate_path_to(power_up.position)
            }
        
        return {"action": "idle"}

class SupportAI(AIController):
    """Support AI that focuses on healing, buffing, and assisting allies."""
    
    def make_decision(self, delta_time: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        if time.time() - self.last_decision_time < self.decision_interval:
            return {"action": "idle"}
            
        self.last_decision_time = time.time()
        
        if not self.robot.is_alive:
            return {"action": "idle"}
        
        allies = self.robot.get_perceived_allies(self.arena.robots)
        enemies = self.robot.get_perceived_enemies(self.arena.robots)
        
        # Check for allies needing help
        low_health_allies = [a for a in allies if a.health < a.max_health * 0.5]
        if low_health_allies:
            closest_low_health = min(low_health_allies, key=lambda a: self.robot.position.distance_to(a.position))
            # Move toward ally in need
            return {
                "action": "move",
                "direction": self.calculate_path_to(closest_low_health.position)
            }
        
        # If we have a support weapon, apply buffs
        if self.robot.weapon:
            # Try to support the closest ally
            closest_ally = self.get_nearest_allied_robot()
            if closest_ally and closest_ally.health < closest_ally.max_health:
                # Use support weapon if available
                if self.robot.weapon.weapon_type == WeaponType.SUPPORT:
                    return {
                        "action": "support",
                        "target": closest_ally.position
                    }
        
        # Look for power-ups to pick up for allies
        power_up = self.get_nearest_power_up()
        if power_up:
            # If power-up is beneficial, move toward it
            if power_up.power_up_type in [PowerUpType.HEALTH_PACK, PowerUpType.AMMO_PACK, PowerUpType.SHIELD]:
                return {
                    "action": "move",
                    "direction": self.calculate_path_to(power_up.position)
                }
        
        # If no immediate allies to help, protect objectives
        objective = self.get_nearest_objective()
        if objective and objective.captured_by == self.robot.team:
            return {
                "action": "move",
                "direction": self.calculate_path_to(objective.position)
            }
        
        # Default: stay near objective or move randomly
        return {"action": "move", "direction": Vector2D(random.uniform(-0.5, 0.5), random.uniform(-0.5, 0.5)).normalize()}

@dataclass
class Vector2D:
    """2D vector for position, velocity, and direction."""
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def __truediv__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x / scalar, self.y / scalar)
    
    def magnitude(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        mag = self.magnitude()
        if mag == 0:
            return Vector2D(0, 0)
        return self / mag
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).magnitude()
    
    def dot(self, other):
        return self.x * other.x + self.y * other.y

class Robot:
    """Represents a single robot in the arena."""
    id: int

    strategy: str = "aggressive"  # aggressive, defensive, balanced, adaptive
    cooldowns: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)  # weapon, ability cooldowns
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        if not self.team:
            self.team = TEAM_COLORS[0]
        self.team_contributions = {team: 0 for team in TEAM_COLORS}
        self.cooldowns = {}
        
    def take_damage(self, damage: float, source: str = "unknown") -> bool:
        """Apply damage to robot with armor reduction."""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return False
            
        # Apply armor reduction first
        actual_damage = damage * (1 - min(self.armor, 0.9))  # Max 90% reduction
        self.health -= actual_damage
        
        # Check if robot is dead
        if self.health <= 0:
            self.is_alive = False
            self.health = 0
            return False
            
        return True
    
    def heal(self, amount: float):
        """Heal robot up to maximum health."""
        if self.is_alive:
            self.health = min(self.health + amount, self.max_health)
    
    def recharge_energy(self, amount: float):
        """Recharge robot's energy."""
        if self.is_alive:
            self.energy = min(self.energy + amount, self.max_energy)
    
    def add_cooldown(self, ability: str, duration: float):
        """Add cooldown to an ability."""
        self.cooldowns[ability] = time.time() + duration
    
    def is_on_cooldown(self, ability: str) -> bool:
        """Check if an ability is on cooldown."""
        if ability not in self.cooldowns:
            return False
        return time.time() < self.cooldowns[ability]
    
    def use_energy(self, cost: float) -> bool:
        """Use energy if available."""
        if self.energy >= cost:
            self.energy -= cost
            return True
        return False
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        """Update robot state."""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return
            
        # Update cooldowns
        to_remove = []
        for ability, end_time in self.cooldowns.items():
            if time.time() >= end_time:
                to_remove.append(ability)
        for ability in to_remove:
            del self.cooldowns[ability]
        
        # Apply velocity to position
        self.position = self.position + (self.velocity * delta_time)
        
        # Apply friction
        friction = 0.95
        self.velocity = self.velocity * friction
        
        # Clamp position to arena bounds
        self.position.x = max(0, min(self.position.x, WORLD_WIDTH))
        self.position.y = max(0, min(self.position.y, WORLD_HEIGHT))
        
        # Regenerate energy slowly
        if self.energy < self.max_energy:
            self.energy += 0.5 * delta_time  # 0.5 per second
        
        # Regenerate health slowly if above 0
        if self.health < self.max_health and self.is_alive:
            self.health += 0.05 * delta_time  # 0.05 per second
    
    def get_perceived_enemies(self, all_robots: List['Robot']) -> List['Robot']:
        """Get list of perceived enemy robots."""
        if not self.is_alive:

        enemies = []
        for robot in all_robots:
            if robot.team != self.team and robot.is_alive:
                distance = self.position.distance_to(robot.position)
                # Perception range (can be influenced by role or abilities)
                perception_range = 200 if self.role != "scout" else 350
                if distance <= perception_range:
                    enemies.append(robot)
        
        return enemies
    
    def get_perceived_allies(self, all_robots: List['Robot']) -> List['Robot']:

        allies = []
        for robot in all_robots:

                if distance <= perception_range:
                    allies.append(robot)
        
        return allies

    def update(self, robots: List[Robot], delta_time: float):
        """Update objective progress based on nearby robots."""
        if self.is_complete:

        # Check for robots from required team in capture radius
        nearby_robots = [r for r in robots if r.team == self.team_required and 
                        r.position.distance_to(self.position) <= self.capture_radius and r.is_alive]
        
        if len(nearby_robots) > 0:
            # Progress increases based on number of robots

            self.progress = min(self.max_progress, self.progress + progress_increase)
            
            # If objective is fully captured

        # Check if all robots from one team are eliminated
        team_1_alive = sum(1 for r in self.robots if r.team == TEAM_COLORS[0] and r.is_alive)
        team_2_alive = sum(1 for r in self.robots if r.team == TEAM_COLORS[1] and r.is_alive)
        
        if team_1_alive == 0 or team_2_alive == 0:
            # Round ends when one team is eliminated
            winner = TEAM_COLORS[0] if team_2_alive == 0 else TEAM_COLORS[1]
            self.team_scores[winner] += 100  # Bonus for winning round
            self.game_state = GameState.ENDED
            
            # Add objective-based rewards
            for objective in self.objectives:
                if objective.is_complete and objective.captured_by:
                    self.team_scores[objective.captured_by] += 30
            
            return
        
        # Check if all objectives are completed
        completed_objectives = sum(1 for o in self.objectives if o.is_complete)
        if completed_objectives == len(self.objectives):
            # Find which team has more objectives captured
            team1_objectives = sum(1 for o in self.objectives if o.captured_by == TEAM_COLORS[0])
            team2_objectives = sum(1 for o in self.objectives if o.captured_by == TEAM_COLORS[1])

            elif team2_objectives > team1_objectives:
                winner = TEAM_COLORS[1]
            else:
                # Tie - no winner
                return

            self.game_state = GameState.ENDED
            return

        if self.time >= 120.0:

            if self.team_scores[TEAM_COLORS[0]] > self.team_scores[TEAM_COLORS[1]]:

            if winner:

            self.game_state = GameState.ENDED
    
    def adjust_difficulty(self):
        """Adjust AI difficulty based on team performance."""
        team1_score = self.team_scores[TEAM_COLORS[0]]
        team2_score = self.team_scores[TEAM_COLORS[1]]
        
        # Increase difficulty if one team is dominating
        if abs(team1_score - team2_score) > 150:
            # Make the weaker team's AI more aggressive
            if team1_score > team2_score:
                self.difficulty_level = 1.2  # Increase difficulty for team 1
            else:

        for robot in self.robots:
            if robot.is_alive:
                # Increase AI aggression and accuracy with difficulty
                if robot.role == "attacker":
                    robot.strategy = "aggressive" if self.difficulty_level > 1.0 else "balanced"
                elif robot.role == "defender":
                    robot.strategy = "defensive" if self.difficulty_level > 1.0 else "balanced"

class AIController(ABC):
    """Abstract base class for AI controllers."""
    
    def __init__(self, robot: Robot, arena: Arena):
        self.robot = robot
        self.arena = arena
        self.ai_memory: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        self.last_decision_time = 0.0
        self.decision_interval = 0.5  # seconds between AI decisions
        
    @abstractmethod
    def make_decision(self, delta_time: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Make an AI decision based on current state."""
        pass
    
    def get_nearest_enemy(self) -> Optional[Robot]:
        """Get the nearest enemy robot."""
        enemies = self.robot.get_perceived_enemies(self.arena.robots)
        if not enemies:
            return None
        return min(enemies, key=lambda e: self.robot.position.distance_to(e.position))
    
    def get_nearest_allied_robot(self) -> Optional[Robot]:
        """Get the nearest allied robot."""
        allies = self.robot.get_perceived_allies(self.arena.robots)
        if not allies:
            return None
        return min(allies, key=lambda a: self.robot.position.distance_to(a.position))
    
    def get_nearest_power_up(self) -> Optional[PowerUp]:
        """Get the nearest power-up."""
        if not self.arena.power_ups:
            return None
        return min(self.arena.power_ups, key=lambda p: self.robot.position.distance_to(p.position))
    
    def get_nearest_objective(self) -> Optional[Objective]:
        """Get the nearest objective for this robot's team."""
        objectives = [o for o in self.arena.objectives if o.team_required == self.robot.team]
        if not objectives:
            return None
        return min(objectives, key=lambda o: self.robot.position.distance_to(o.position))
    
    def get_nearest_hazard(self) -> Optional[Hazard]:
        """Get the nearest hazard."""
        if not self.arena.hazards:
            return None
        return min(self.arena.hazards, key=lambda h: self.robot.position.distance_to(h.position))
    
    def calculate_path_to(self, target: Vector2D) -> Vector2D:
        """Calculate a direction vector toward target."""
        direction = (target - self.robot.position).normalize()
        return direction

class AggressiveAI(AIController):
    """Aggressive AI that prioritizes attacking enemies."""
    
    def make_decision(self, delta_time: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        if time.time() - self.last_decision_time < self.decision_interval:
            return {"action": "idle"}
            
        self.last_decision_time = time.time()
        
        # Check if robot is dead or has no weapon
        if not self.robot.is_alive or not self.robot.weapon:
            return {"action": "idle"}
        
        # Get nearest enemy
        enemy = self.get_nearest_enemy()
        if enemy and self.robot.weapon.can_fire(self.robot):
            # Calculate direction to enemy
            direction = self.calculate_path_to(enemy.position)
            
            # If enemy is in range, fire
            if self.robot.position.distance_to(enemy.position) <= self.robot.weapon.range:
                return {
                    "action": "fire",
                    "target": enemy.position
                }
            else:
                # Move toward enemy
                return {
                    "action": "move",
                    "direction": direction
                }
        
        # If no enemy in range, try to find power-up
        power_up = self.get_nearest_power_up()
        if power_up and power_up.active:
            if self.robot.position.distance_to(power_up.position) < 150:
                return {
                    "action": "move",
                    "direction": self.calculate_path_to(power_up.position)
                }
        
        # Otherwise, patrol or find objectives
        objective = self.get_nearest_objective()
        if objective and objective.captured_by != self.robot.team:
            return {
                "action": "move",
                "direction": self.calculate_path_to(objective.position)
            }
        
        # Default: move randomly
        return {
            "action": "move",
            "direction": Vector2D(random.uniform(-1, 1), random.uniform(-1, 1)).normalize()
        }

class DefensiveAI(AIController):
    """Defensive AI that prioritizes protecting objectives and allies."""
    
    def make_decision(self, delta_time: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        if time.time() - self.last_decision_time < self.decision_interval:
            return {"action": "idle"}
            
        self.last_decision_time = time.time()
        
        if not self.robot.is_alive or not self.robot.weapon:
            return {"action": "idle"}
        
        # Check if a teammate is under attack
        enemies = self.robot.get_perceived_enemies(self.arena.robots)
        allies = self.robot.get_perceived_allies(self.arena.robots)
        
        # Prioritize protecting objectives
        objective = self.get_nearest_objective()
        if objective:
            if objective.captured_by == self.robot.team:
                # Defend our captured objective
                if self.robot.position.distance_to(objective.position) > 100:
                    return {
                        "action": "move",
                        "direction": self.calculate_path_to(objective.position)
                    }
                # If enemy is near objective, attack
                for enemy in enemies:
                    if enemy.position.distance_to(objective.position) < 150:
                        if self.robot.weapon.can_fire(self.robot):
                            return {
                                "action": "fire",
                                "target": enemy.position
                            }
                        else:
                            return {
                                "action": "move",
                                "direction": self.calculate_path_to(enemy.position)
                            }
            else:
                # Try to capture enemy objective
                if self.robot.position.distance_to(objective.position) > 100:
                    return {
                        "action": "move",
                        "direction": self.calculate_path_to(objective.position)
                    }
        
        # Protect nearest ally under threat
        for ally in allies:
            for enemy in enemies:
                if ally.position.distance_to(enemy.position) < 100:
                    # Ally is threatened, move to protect
                    if self.robot.weapon.can_fire(self.robot):
                        return {
                            "action": "fire",
                            "target": enemy.position
                        }
                    else:
                        return {
                            "action": "move",
                            "direction": self.calculate_path_to(ally.position)
                        }
        
        # If no immediate threats, patrol around objective
        if objective:
            # Move in a circular pattern around objective
            angle = (self.robot.id * 0.1 + self.arena.time) % (2 * math.pi)
            offset = Vector2D(
                math.cos(angle) * 80,
                math.sin(angle) * 80
            )
            patrol_point = objective.position + offset
            return {
                "action": "move",
                "direction": self.calculate_path_to(patrol_point)
            }
        
        # Default: move to nearest power-up
        power_up = self.get_nearest_power_up()
        if power_up and power_up.active:
            return {
                "action": "move",
                "direction": self.calculate_path_to(power_up.position)
            }
        
        return {"action": "idle"}

    def __add__(self, other):
        return Vector2(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def __truediv__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2(self.x / scalar, self.y / scalar)
    
    def magnitude(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        mag = self.magnitude()
        if mag == 0:
            return Vector2(0, 0)
        return self / mag
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).magnitude()

@dataclass
class Vector2:
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        return Vector2(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def __truediv__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2(self.x / scalar, self.y / scalar)
    
    def magnitude(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        mag = self.magnitude()
        if mag == 0:
            return Vector2(0, 0)
        return self / mag
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).magnitude()
    
    def to_tuple(self):
        return (self.x, self.y)

    max_health: float = DEFAULT_ROBOT_HEALTH
    speed: float = DEFAULT_ROBOT_SPEED
    weapon: str = "plasma_rifle"
    weapon_cooldown: float = 0.0
    state: AIState = AIState.IDLE
    role: str = "scout"
    last_seen_enemy: Optional[Vector2] = None
    objective: Optional[str] = None
    power_ups: Dict[PowerUpType, float] = field(default_factory=dict)  # power_up_type -> duration
    is_alive: bool = True
    last_update: float = 0.0
    experience: float = 0.0
    kills: int = 0
    assists: int = 0
    objectives_completed: int = 0
    
    def apply_damage(self, damage: float) -> bool:
        """Apply damage to robot, return True if robot dies"""
        self.health = max(0, self.health - damage)
        if self.health <= 0:
            self.is_alive = False
            return True
        return False
    
    def heal(self, amount: float) -> None:
        """Heal robot by specified amount"""
        self.health = min(self.max_health, self.health + amount)
    
    def add_power_up(self, power_up_type: PowerUpType, duration: float) -> None:
        """Add a power-up with specified duration"""
        self.power_ups[power_up_type] = duration
    
    def update_power_ups(self, delta_time: float) -> None:
        """Update power-up durations and remove expired ones"""
        expired = []
        for power_up, duration in self.power_ups.items():
            self.power_ups[power_up] = duration - delta_time
            if self.power_ups[power_up] <= 0:
                expired.append(power_up)
        
        for power_up in expired:
            del self.power_ups[power_up]
    
    def get_effective_speed(self) -> float:
        """Get current speed with power-up effects"""
        speed = self.speed
        if PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST in self.power_ups:
            speed *= 1.5
        return speed

@dataclass
class Weapon:
    name: str
    weapon_type: WeaponType
    damage: float
    range: float
    cooldown: float
    projectile_speed: float = 20.0
    area_effect: bool = False
    area_radius: float = 0.0
    
    def can_attack(self, target_position: Vector2, source_position: Vector2) -> bool:
        """Check if weapon can attack target from source position"""
        distance = source_position.distance_to(target_position)
        return distance <= self.range

@dataclass
class Objective:
    id: str
    type: ObjectiveType
    position: Vector2
    team_required: str
    capture_progress: float = 0.0
    captured_by: Optional[str] = None
    is_active: bool = True
    associated_payload: Optional[str] = None  # For escort objectives

@dataclass
class PowerUp:

    position: Vector2
    duration: float = 10.0
    spawn_time: float = 0.0
    is_active: bool = True

@dataclass
class Hazard:

@dataclass
class GameState:

@dataclass
class RobotAI:
    robot: Robot
    game_state: GameState
    team_robots: List[Robot]
    enemy_robots: List[Robot]
    memory: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    strategy_history: List[Dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    
    def think(self, delta_time: float) -> None:
        """Main AI decision-making function"""
        if not self.robot.is_alive:
            return
            
        # Update memory based on current state
        self._update_memory()
        
        # Determine optimal behavior based on current state and history
        new_state = self._determine_behavior(delta_time)
        
        # Apply behavior changes
        if new_state != self.robot.state:
            self.robot.state = new_state
            # Record strategy change for learning
            self.strategy_history.append({
                'time': self.game_state.time,
                'old_state': self.robot.state.value if hasattr(self.robot.state, 'value') else str(self.robot.state),
                'new_state': new_state.value if hasattr(new_state, 'value') else str(new_state),
                'team': self.robot.team,
                'robot_id': self.robot.id
            })
        
        # Execute behavior
        self._execute_behavior(delta_time)
    
    def _update_memory(self) -> None:
        """Update AI memory with current observations"""
        # Track last known enemy positions
        closest_enemy = self._find_closest_enemy()
        if closest_enemy:
            self.robot.last_seen_enemy = closest_enemy.position
        
        # Track team positions for coordination
        team_positions = [r.position for r in self.team_robots if r.is_alive]
        self.memory['team_positions'] = team_positions
        
        # Track nearby power-ups and hazards
        nearby_power_ups = [pu for pu in self.game_state.power_ups 
                           if pu.is_active and pu.position.distance_to(self.robot.position) < 150]
        self.memory['nearby_power_ups'] = nearby_power_ups
        
        nearby_hazards = [h for h in self.game_state.hazards 
                         if h.active and h.position.distance_to(self.robot.position) < 100]
        self.memory['nearby_hazards'] = nearby_hazards
        
        # Track objective status
        if self.game_state.current_objective:
            self.memory['current_objective'] = self.game_state.current_objective
    
    def _determine_behavior(self, delta_time: float) -> AIState:
        """Determine the most appropriate behavior based on current state"""
        
        # If robot is dead or incapacitated, return IDLE
        if not self.robot.is_alive:
            return AIState.IDLE
        
        # Check health - retreat if low
        if self.robot.health < self.robot.max_health * 0.2 and self.robot.state != AIState.RETREAT:
            return AIState.RETREAT
        
        # Check for nearby power-ups
        if self.memory.get('nearby_power_ups'):
            closest_power_up = min(self.memory['nearby_power_ups'], 
                                 key=lambda pu: pu.position.distance_to(self.robot.position))
            if closest_power_up.type == PowerUpType.HEALTH_PACK and self.robot.health < self.robot.max_health * 0.6:
                return AIState.CAPTURE
            elif closest_power_up.type in [PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST, PowerUpType.DAMAGE_BOOST]:
                return AIState.CAPTURE
        
        # Check for nearby hazards
        if self.memory.get('nearby_hazards'):
            closest_hazard = min(self.memory['nearby_hazards'], 
                               key=lambda h: h.position.distance_to(self.robot.position))
            if closest_hazard.damage_per_second > 0:
                # If hazard is dangerous, avoid it
                return AIState.PATROL
        
        # Check for objectives
        if self.game_state.current_objective:
            obj = self.game_state.current_objective
            # If this robot's team needs to capture/defend this objective
            if obj.team_required == self.robot.team:
                if obj.type == ObjectiveType.CAPTURE_FLAG:
                    if obj.captured_by == self.robot.team:
                        return AIState.DEFEND
                    else:
                        return AIState.CAPTURE
                elif obj.type == ObjectiveType.DEFEND_BASE:
                    return AIState.DEFEND
                elif obj.type == ObjectiveType.ESCAPE_PAYLOAD:
                    return AIState.ESCAPING
        
        # Find closest enemy
        closest_enemy = self._find_closest_enemy()
        if closest_enemy:
            distance_to_enemy = self.robot.position.distance_to(closest_enemy.position)
            
            # If enemy is close and weapon is ready, attack
            weapon = self._get_robot_weapon(self.robot.weapon)
            if (weapon and weapon.can_attack(closest_enemy.position, self.robot.position) and 
                self.robot.weapon_cooldown <= 0):
                return AIState.ATTACK
            
            # If enemy is within range but weapon is on cooldown, move towards
            if distance_to_enemy < weapon.range if weapon else 200:
                return AIState.ATTACK
        
        # If no immediate threats, patrol or explore
        if self.robot.role == "scout":
            return AIState.PATROL
        elif self.robot.role == "support":
            return AIState.DEFEND
        else:
            return AIState.PATROL
    
    def _find_closest_enemy(self) -> Optional[Robot]:
        """Find the closest enemy robot"""
        if not self.enemy_robots:
            return None
        
        alive_enemies = [e for e in self.enemy_robots if e.is_alive]
        if not alive_enemies:
            return None
        
        return min(alive_enemies, key=lambda e: self.robot.position.distance_to(e.position))
    
    def _get_robot_weapon(self, weapon_name: str) -> Optional[Weapon]:
        """Retrieve weapon definition for robot"""
        weapons = {
            "plasma_rifle": Weapon("plasma_rifle", WeaponType.RANGED, 15, 300, 0.8, 25),
            "shotgun": Weapon("shotgun", WeaponType.RANGED, 25, 100, 1.5, 15, True, 50),
            "plasma_blade": Weapon("plasma_blade", WeaponType.MELEE, 50, 80, 1.2, 5),
            "healing_pulse": Weapon("healing_pulse", WeaponType.SUPPORT, 0, 150, 3.0),
            "grenade": Weapon("grenade", WeaponType.RANGED, 40, 200, 2.0, 10, True, 100)
        }
        return weapons.get(weapon_name)
    
    def _execute_behavior(self, delta_time: float) -> None:
        """Execute the current behavior"""
        weapon = self._get_robot_weapon(self.robot.weapon)
        
        if self.robot.state == AIState.ATTACK:
            self._execute_attack(delta_time)
        elif self.robot.state == AIState.DEFEND:
            self._execute_defend(delta_time)
        elif self.robot.state == AIState.CAPTURE:
            self._execute_capture(delta_time)
        elif self.robot.state == AIState.ESCAPE:
            self._execute_escort(delta_time)
        elif self.robot.state == AIState.PATROL:
            self._execute_patrol(delta_time)
        elif self.robot.state == AIState.RETREAT:
            self._execute_retreat(delta_time)
        elif self.robot.state == AIState.IDLE:
            self._execute_idle(delta_time)
        
        # Update cooldown
        if weapon and self.robot.weapon_cooldown > 0:
            self.robot.weapon_cooldown -= delta_time
    
    def _execute_attack(self, delta_time: float) -> None:
        """Execute attack behavior"""
        closest_enemy = self._find_closest_enemy()
        if not closest_enemy or not closest_enemy.is_alive:
            return
        
        # Move towards enemy if outside weapon range
        weapon = self._get_robot_weapon(self.robot.weapon)
        distance = self.robot.position.distance_to(closest_enemy.position)
        
        if weapon and distance > weapon.range * 0.8:
            # Move toward enemy
            direction = (closest_enemy.position - self.robot.position).normalize()
            move_distance = self.robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time
            self.robot.position = self.robot.position + direction * move_distance
            
            # Clamp position to game boundaries
            self.robot.position.x = max(0, min(self.robot.position.x, GAME_WIDTH))
            self.robot.position.y = max(0, min(self.robot.position.y, GAME_HEIGHT))
        elif weapon and distance <= weapon.range and self.robot.weapon_cooldown <= 0:
            # Fire weapon
            self._attack_target(closest_enemy)
    
    def _execute_defend(self, delta_time: float) -> None:
        """Execute defend behavior"""
        if not self.game_state.current_objective:
            return
        
        obj = self.game_state.current_objective
        # Move toward objective if far away
        distance_to_obj = self.robot.position.distance_to(obj.position)
        
        if distance_to_obj > 150:
            direction = (obj.position - self.robot.position).normalize()
            move_distance = self.robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time
            self.robot.position = self.robot.position + direction * move_distance
            # Clamp position
            self.robot.position.x = max(0, min(self.robot.position.x, GAME_WIDTH))
            self.robot.position.y = max(0, min(self.robot.position.y, GAME_HEIGHT))
        
        # Look for enemies near objective
        closest_enemy = self._find_closest_enemy()
        if closest_enemy:
            weapon = self._get_robot_weapon(self.robot.weapon)
            if weapon and weapon.can_attack(closest_enemy.position, self.robot.position) and self.robot.weapon_cooldown <= 0:
                self._attack_target(closest_enemy)
    
    def _execute_capture(self, delta_time: float) -> None:
        """Execute capture behavior"""
        # Look for objectives to capture
        if not self.game_state.current_objective:
            return
        
        obj = self.game_state.current_objective
        if obj.team_required != self.robot.team and obj.captured_by != self.robot.team:
            # Capture objective
            distance_to_obj = self.robot.position.distance_to(obj.position)
            
            if distance_to_obj < 50:
                # Start capturing
                obj.capture_progress = min(1.0, obj.capture_progress + 0.005 * delta_time)
                if obj.capture_progress >= 1.0:
                    obj.captured_by = self.robot.team
                    self.robot.objectives_completed += 1
                    # Award experience
                    self.robot.experience += 20
            else:
                # Move toward objective
                direction = (obj.position - self.robot.position).normalize()
                move_distance = self.robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time
                self.robot.position = self.robot.position + direction * move_distance
                # Clamp position
                self.robot.position.x = max(0, min(self.robot.position.x, GAME_WIDTH))
                self.robot.position.y = max(0, min(self.robot.position.y, GAME_HEIGHT))
        else:
            # Look for power-ups to collect
            if self.memory.get('nearby_power_ups'):
                closest_power_up = min(self.memory['nearby_power_ups'], 
                                     key=lambda pu: pu.position.distance_to(self.robot.position))
                distance_to_power = self.robot.position.distance_to(closest_power_up.position)
                
                if distance_to_power < 50:
                    # Collect power-up
                    self.robot.add_power_up(closest_power_up.type, closest_power_up.duration)
                    closest_power_up.is_active = False
                    # Award experience
                    self.robot.experience += 10
                else:
                    # Move toward power-up
                    direction = (closest_power_up.position - self.robot.position).normalize()
                    move_distance = self.robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time
                    self.robot.position = self.robot.position + direction * move_distance
                    # Clamp position
                    self.robot.position.x = max(0, min(self.robot.position.x, GAME_WIDTH))
                    self.robot.position.y = max(0, min(self.robot.position.y, GAME_HEIGHT))
    
    def _execute_escort(self, delta_time: float) -> None:
        """Execute escort behavior"""
        # This is a placeholder - actual implementation would depend on payload tracking
        pass
    
    def _execute_patrol(self, delta_time: float) -> None:
        """Execute patrol behavior"""
        # If no patrol path defined, create a random one
        if 'patrol_path' not in self.memory:
            # Define 3 random patrol points
            self.memory['patrol_path'] = [
                Vector2(random.randint(100, GAME_WIDTH-100), random.randint(100, GAME_HEIGHT-100)),
                Vector2(random.randint(100, GAME_WIDTH-100), random.randint(100, GAME_HEIGHT-100)),
                Vector2(random.randint(100, GAME_WIDTH-100), random.randint(100, GAME_HEIGHT-100))
            ]
            self.memory['patrol_index'] = 0
        
        # Move to next patrol point
        target = self.memory['patrol_path'][self.memory['patrol_index']]
        distance_to_target = self.robot.position.distance_to(target)
        
        if distance_to_target < 50:
            # Reached current point, move to next
            self.memory['patrol_index'] = (self.memory['patrol_index'] + 1) % len(self.memory['patrol_path'])
            target = self.memory['patrol_path'][self.memory['patrol_index']]
        
        # Move toward target
        direction = (target - self.robot.position).normalize()
        move_distance = self.robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time
        self.robot.position = self.robot.position + direction * move_distance
        
        # Clamp position
        self.robot.position.x = max(0, min(self.robot.position.x, GAME_WIDTH))
        self.robot.position.y = max(0, min(self.robot.position.y, GAME_HEIGHT))
    
    def _execute_retreat(self, delta_time: float) -> None:
        """Execute retreat behavior"""
        # Find safe position - away from enemies and hazards
        closest_enemy = self._find_closest_enemy()
        
        if closest_enemy and closest_enemy.is_alive:
            # Move away from enemy
            direction = (self.robot.position - closest_enemy.position).normalize()
            move_distance = self.robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time * 0.7  # Slower retreat
            self.robot.position = self.robot.position + direction * move_distance
        else:
            # Move toward team if possible
            team_positions = self.memory.get('team_positions', [])
            if team_positions:
                avg_team_pos = Vector2(
                    sum(p.x for p in team_positions) / len(team_positions),
                    sum(p.y for p in team_positions) / len(team_positions)
                )
                direction = (avg_team_pos - self.robot.position).normalize()
                move_distance = self.robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time
                self.robot.position = self.robot.position + direction * move_distance
        
        # Clamp position
        self.robot.position.x = max(0, min(self.robot.position.x, GAME_WIDTH))
        self.robot.position.y = max(0, min(self.robot.position.y, GAME_HEIGHT))
    
    def _execute_idle(self, delta_time: float) -> None:
        """Execute idle behavior"""
        # If idle, just stay in position or make small movements
        if random.random() < 0.02:  # 2% chance to move randomly
            direction = Vector2(random.uniform(-1, 1), random.uniform(-1, 1)).normalize()
            move_distance = self.robot.get_effective_speed() * delta_time * 0.3
            self.robot.position = self.robot.position + direction * move_distance
            
            # Clamp position
            self.robot.position.x = max(0, min(self.robot.position.x, GAME_WIDTH))
            self.robot.position.y = max(0, min(self.robot.position.y, GAME_HEIGHT))
    
    def _attack_target(self, target: Robot) -> None:
        """Perform attack on target"""
        weapon = self._get_robot_weapon(self.robot.weapon)
        
        if not weapon or weapon.weapon_type == WeaponType.SUPPORT:
            return
            
        # Apply damage
        damage = weapon.damage
        if weapon.area_effect:
            # Area effect damage to nearby robots
            for robot in self.enemy_robots:
                if robot.is_alive and self.robot.position.distance_to(robot.position) <= weapon.area_radius:
                    if robot.apply_damage(damage):
                        # Kill event
                        self.robot.kills += 1
                        self.robot.experience += 15
        else:
            # Direct damage
            if target.apply_damage(damage):
                # Kill event
                self.robot.kills += 1
                self.robot.experience += 15
                # Award assist to nearby teammates
                for teammate in self.team_robots:
                    if teammate.is_alive and teammate.id != self.robot.id:
                        if teammate.position.distance_to(target.position) < 150:
                            teammate.assists += 1
                            teammate.experience += 5
        
        # Reset cooldown
        self.robot.weapon_cooldown = weapon.cooldown

class CyberArena:
    def __init__(self):
        self.robots: List[Robot] = []
        self.game_state: GameState = GameState()
        self.ai_controllers: List[RobotAI] = []
        self.weapons: Dict[str, Weapon] = {
            "plasma_rifle": Weapon("plasma_rifle", WeaponType.RANGED, 15, 300, 0.8, 25),
            "shotgun": Weapon("shotgun", WeaponType.RANGED, 25, 100, 1.5, 15, True, 50),
            "plasma_blade": Weapon("plasma_blade", WeaponType.MELEE, 50, 80, 1.2, 5),
            "healing_pulse": Weapon("healing_pulse", WeaponType.SUPPORT, 0, 150, 3.0),
            "grenade": Weapon("grenade", WeaponType.RANGED, 40, 200, 2.0, 10, True, 100)
        }
        self.power_ups: List[PowerUp] = []
        self.hazards: List[Hazard] = []
        
        # Learning system
        self.strategy_performance: Dict[str, List[float]] = defaultdict(list)  # strategy -> performance_scores
        self.learning_rate = 0.1
        self.exploration_rate = 0.3
        
        # Audio/visual simulation
        self.sound_effects: Dict[str, List[str]] = {
            "attack": ["plasma_shoot_1.wav", "plasma_shoot_2.wav", "pulse_fire.wav"],
            "explosion": ["explosion_small.wav", "explosion_large.wav"],
            "power_up": ["power_up_collect.wav", "power_up_activate.wav"],
            "damage": ["robot_damage_1.wav", "robot_damage_2.wav", "robot_damage_3.wav"],
            "death": ["robot_death_1.wav", "robot_death_2.wav"]
        }
        
        # Particle system simulation
        self.particles: List[Dict] = []
        
        # Initialize game
        self._initialize_game()
    
    def _initialize_game(self) -> None:
        """Initialize game with robots, objectives, power-ups, and hazards"""
        # Generate teams
        team_names = ["Red", "Blue", "Green", "Yellow"][:MAX_TEAMS]
        
        # Create robots for each team
        robot_id = 0
        for team_name in team_names:
            # Determine number of robots per team (randomized between 1-5)
            robot_count = random.randint(1, MAX_ROBOTS_PER_TEAM)
            
            for _ in range(robot_count):
                # Random starting position on the team's side
                if team_name == "Red":
                    x = random.randint(50, 200)
                    y = random.randint(50, GAME_HEIGHT - 50)
                elif team_name == "Blue":
                    x = random.randint(GAME_WIDTH - 200, GAME_WIDTH - 50)
                    y = random.randint(50, GAME_HEIGHT - 50)
                elif team_name == "Green":
                    x = random.randint(GAME_WIDTH // 2 - 100, GAME_WIDTH // 2 + 100)
                    y = random.randint(50, 150)
                else:  # Yellow
                    x = random.randint(GAME_WIDTH // 2 - 100, GAME_WIDTH // 2 + 100)
                    y = random.randint(GAME_HEIGHT - 150, GAME_HEIGHT - 50)
                
                # Random weapon assignment
                weapons = list(self.weapons.keys())
                weapon_name = random.choice(weapons)
                
                # Random role assignment
                roles = ["scout", "soldier", "support", "tank"]
                role = random.choice(roles)
                
                robot = Robot(
                    id=robot_id,
                    team=team_name,
                    position=Vector2(x, y),
                    weapon=weapon_name,
                    role=role
                )
                self.robots.append(robot)
                robot_id += 1
        
        # Set up objectives
        objective_types = [ObjectiveType.CAPTURE_FLAG, ObjectiveType.DEFEND_BASE, ObjectiveType.ESCAPE_PAYLOAD]
        for i, team_name in enumerate(team_names):
            if i == 0:
                # First team gets a capture flag objective
                obj = Objective(
                    id=f"obj_{i}",
                    type=ObjectiveType.CAPTURE_FLAG,
                    position=Vector2(GAME_WIDTH // 2, GAME_HEIGHT // 2),
                    team_required=team_name
                )
                self.game_state.objectives.append(obj)
                self.game_state.current_objective = obj
            elif i == 1:
                # Second team gets a defend base
                obj = Objective(
                    id=f"obj_{i}",
                    type=ObjectiveType.DEFEND_BASE,
                    position=Vector2(GAME_WIDTH // 3, GAME_HEIGHT // 3),
                    team_required=team_name
                )
                self.game_state.objectives.append(obj)
            elif i == 2:
                # Third team gets an escort payload (simulated)
                obj = Objective(
                    id=f"obj_{i}",
                    type=ObjectiveType.ESCAPE_PAYLOAD,
                    position=Vector2(GAME_WIDTH * 2 // 3, GAME_HEIGHT * 2 // 3),
                    team_required=team_name,
                    associated_payload=f"payload_{i}"
                )

@dataclass
class Vector2:
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        return Vector2(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def __truediv__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2(self.x / scalar, self.y / scalar)
    
    def magnitude(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        mag = self.magnitude()
        if mag == 0:
            return Vector2(0, 0)
        return self / mag
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).magnitude()
    
    def to_tuple(self):
        return (self.x, self.y)

@dataclass
class Vector2D:
    """2D Position and Velocity Vector"""
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    
    def distance_to(self, other: 'Vector2D') -> float:
        return math.sqrt((self.x - other.x)**2 + (self.y - other.y)**2)
    
    def normalize(self) -> 'Vector2D':
        mag = math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
        if mag > 0:
            return Vector2D(self.x/mag, self.y/mag)
        return Vector2D(0, 0)
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def __rmul__(self, scalar):
        return self.__mul__(scalar)

    """Represents a single AI-controlled robot in the arena"""

        if not self.weapon:
            self.weapon = Weapon(WeaponType.RANGED, damage=25, cooldown=1.5, range=150)
    
    def take_damage(self, amount: float) -> bool:
        """Apply damage to the robot and return True if killed"""
        self.health = max(0, self.health - amount)
        if self.health <= 0:
            self.is_active = False
            logger.info(f"Robot {self.id} ({self.team.value}) has been eliminated!")
            return True
        return False
    
    def heal(self, amount: float):
        """Heal the robot"""
        self.health = min(self.max_health, self.health + amount)
    
    def consume_energy(self, amount: float) -> bool:
        """Consume energy and return True if enough energy available"""
        if self.energy >= amount:
            self.energy -= amount
            return True
        return False
    
    def regenerate_energy(self, rate: float, delta_time: float):
        """Regenerate energy over time"""
        self.energy = min(self.max_energy, self.energy + rate * delta_time)

        """Update robot's memory for learning"""
        self.memory[key] = value

        """Fire the weapon, return success"""

            self.last_fired = current_time
            return True
        return False
    
    def get_state(self) -> Dict:

            self.activation_time = current_time

class AIBehaviorTree:
    """Behavior tree for robot decision making"""
    
    def __init__(self, robot: Robot, game_state: GameState):
        self.robot = robot
        self.game_state = game_state
        self.tree = self._build_behavior_tree()
        self.last_tree_evaluation = 0.0
        self.current_action = None
    
    def _build_behavior_tree(self) -> Dict:
        """Build the behavior tree structure"""
        return {
            "type": "sequence",
            "children": [
                {
                    "type": "selector",
                    "children": [
                        {
                            "type": "condition",
                            "name": "low_health",
                            "check": lambda: self.robot.health < self.robot.max_health * 0.3
                        },
                        {
                            "type": "action",
                            "name": "seek_heal",
                            "action": self._seek_heal
                        }
                    ]
                },
                {
                    "type": "selector",
                    "children": [
                        {
                            "type": "condition",
                            "name": "has_objective",
                            "check": lambda: len(self.robot.objectives) > 0
                        },
                        {
                            "type": "action",
                            "name": "pursue_objective",
                            "action": self._pursue_objective
                        }
                    ]
                },
                {
                    "type": "selector",
                    "children": [
                        {
                            "type": "condition",
                            "name": "enemy_nearby",
                            "check": self._enemy_nearby
                        },
                        {
                            "type": "action",
                            "name": "attack_enemy",
                            "action": self._attack_enemy
                        }
                    ]
                },
                {
                    "type": "selector",
                    "children": [
                        {
                            "type": "condition",
                            "name": "powerup_nearby",
                            "check": self._powerup_nearby
                        },
                        {
                            "type": "action",
                            "name": "collect_powerup",
                            "action": self._collect_powerup
                        }
                    ]
                },
                {
                    "type": "action",
                    "name": "patrol",
                    "action": self._patrol
                }
            ]
        }
    
    def _enemy_nearby(self) -> bool:
        """Check if there's an enemy robot nearby"""
        if not self.robot.is_active:
            return False
            
        for other_robot in self.game_state.robots:
            if (other_robot.team != self.robot.team and 
                other_robot.is_active and 
                self.robot.position.distance_to(other_robot.position) < 80):
                self.robot.last_seen_enemy = other_robot.id
                return True
        return False
    
    def _powerup_nearby(self) -> bool:
        """Check if there's a power-up nearby"""
        for powerup in self.game_state.power_ups:
            if (not powerup.is_collected and 
                self.robot.position.distance_to(powerup.position) < 60):
                return True
        return False
    
    def _seek_heal(self) -> str:
        """Move towards a healing power-up or base"""
        # Look for healing power-ups
        nearest_heal = None
        min_dist = float('inf')
        
        for powerup in self.game_state.power_ups:
            if (powerup.power_up_type == PowerUpType.HEAL and 
                not powerup.is_collected):
                dist = self.robot.position.distance_to(powerup.position)
                if dist < min_dist:
                    min_dist = dist
                    nearest_heal = powerup
        
        if nearest_heal:
            # Move towards heal
            direction = (nearest_heal.position - self.robot.position).normalize()
            self.robot.position = self.robot.position + direction * self.robot.speed * 0.1
            return f"Seeking heal at ({nearest_heal.position.x:.1f}, {nearest_heal.position.y:.1f})"
        
        # If no power-up, return to spawn
        if self.game_state.spawn_points.get(self.robot.team, []):
            spawn = random.choice(self.game_state.spawn_points[self.robot.team])
            direction = (spawn - self.robot.position).normalize()
            self.robot.position = self.robot.position + direction * self.robot.speed * 0.05
            return f"Returning to spawn"
        
        return "Seeking heal (no target)"
    
    def _pursue_objective(self) -> str:
        """Pursue assigned objectives"""
        if not self.robot.objectives:
            return "No objectives"
        
        target_obj = None
        for obj in self.game_state.objectives:
            if obj.objective_type in self.robot.objectives:
                target_obj = obj
                break
        
        if not target_obj:
            return "Objective not found"
        
        # Update objective role
        if target_obj.team == self.robot.team:
            # Defending
            if self.robot.id not in target_obj.defenders:
                target_obj.defenders.append(self.robot.id)
            self.robot.role = "defender"
        else:
            # Attacking
            if self.robot.id not in target_obj.attackers:
                target_obj.attackers.append(self.robot.id)
            self.robot.role = "attacker"
        
        # Move towards objective
        direction = (target_obj.position - self.robot.position).normalize()
        self.robot.position = self.robot.position + direction * self.robot.speed * 0.1
        
        # Check if we're close enough to contribute to objective
        if self.robot.position.distance_to(target_obj.position) < 20:
            # Contribute to objective progress
            progress_increment = 0.5
            if target_obj.team == self.robot.team:
                # Team defending - increase progress
                target_obj.progress = min(target_obj.max_progress, target_obj.progress + progress_increment)
            else:
                # Team attacking - decrease progress
                target_obj.progress = max(0, target_obj.progress - progress_increment)
            
            # If objective is completed
            if target_obj.progress >= target_obj.max_progress and target_obj.team != self.robot.team:
                target_obj.captured_by = self.robot.team
                self.game_state.team_scores[self.robot.team] += 100
                logger.info(f"Team {self.robot.team.value} captured {target_obj.objective_type.value}!")
        
        return f"Pursuing {target_obj.objective_type.value} at ({target_obj.position.x:.1f}, {target_obj.position.y:.1f})"
    
    def _attack_enemy(self) -> str:
        """Attack the nearest enemy"""
        if not self.robot.last_seen_enemy:
            return "No enemy to attack"
        
        target_robot = None
        for robot in self.game_state.robots:
            if robot.id == self.robot.last_seen_enemy:
                target_robot = robot
                break
        
        if not target_robot or not target_robot.is_active:
            self.robot.last_seen_enemy = None
            return "Target lost"
        
        # Calculate distance to target
        distance = self.robot.position.distance_to(target_robot.position)
        
        # Move towards target
        if distance > 20:
            direction = (target_robot.position - self.robot.position).normalize()
            self.robot.position = self.robot.position + direction * self.robot.speed * 0.1
            return f"Moving toward enemy {target_robot.id}"
        
        # Attack if in range
        if distance <= self.robot.weapon.range:
            if self.robot.weapon.fire(time.time()):
                # Apply damage
                damage = self.robot.weapon.damage
                if target_robot.take_damage(damage):
                    # Reward for elimination
                    self.game_state.team_scores[self.robot.team] += 50
                    logger.info(f"Robot {self.robot.id} eliminated {target_robot.id}!")
                    self.robot.last_seen_enemy = None
                    return f"Eliminated {target_robot.id}!"
                
                return f"Attacked {target_robot.id} for {damage} damage!"
        
        return f"Closing in on {target_robot.id}"
    
    def _collect_powerup(self) -> str:
        """Collect the nearest power-up"""
        nearest_powerup = None
        min_dist = float('inf')
        
        for powerup in self.game_state.power_ups:
            if (not powerup.is_collected and 
                self.robot.position.distance_to(powerup.position) < min_dist):
                min_dist = self.robot.position.distance_to(powerup.position)
                nearest_powerup = powerup
        
        if not nearest_powerup:
            return "No power-up to collect"
        
        # Move toward power-up
        if min_dist > 10:
            direction = (nearest_powerup.position - self.robot.position).normalize()
            self.robot.position = self.robot.position + direction * self.robot.speed * 0.1
            return f"Moving toward {nearest_powerup.power_up_type.value}"
        
        # Collect power-up
        self._apply_powerup_effect(nearest_powerup)
        nearest_powerup.is_collected = True
        return f"Collected {nearest_powerup.power_up_type.value}"
    
    def _apply_powerup_effect(self, powerup: PowerUp):
        """Apply the effect of a collected power-up"""
        if powerup.power_up_type == PowerUpType.HEAL:
            self.robot.heal(powerup.value)
        elif powerup.power_up_type == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:
            self.robot.speed *= 1.5
            # Set timer to revert speed
            self.robot.update_memory("speed_boost_end", time.time() + powerup.duration)
        elif powerup.power_up_type == PowerUpType.SHIELD:

            if self.robot.weapon:
                self.robot.weapon.damage *= 1.3
                self.robot.weapon.range *= 1.2
                self.robot.update_memory("weapon_upgrade_end", time.time() + powerup.duration)
        elif powerup.power_up_type == PowerUpType.INVISIBILITY:
            self.robot.update_memory("invisibility_active", True)
            self.robot.update_memory("invisibility_end", time.time() + powerup.duration)

        max_x, max_y = 500, 500  # Arena size

    def evaluate(self, current_time: float) -> str:
        """Evaluate the behavior tree and return the action taken"""
        if current_time - self.last_tree_evaluation < 0.1:  # Limit evaluation rate
            return self.current_action if self.current_action else "Waiting"
        
        self.last_tree_evaluation = current_time
        
        # Evaluate behavior tree
        action_result = self._evaluate_node(self.tree)
        self.current_action = action_result
        return action_result
    
    def _evaluate_node(self, node: Dict) -> str:
        """Recursively evaluate a behavior tree node"""
        if node["type"] == "condition":
            return node["check"]()
        
        elif node["type"] == "action":
            return node["action"]()
        
        elif node["type"] == "sequence":
            for child in node["children"]:
                result = self._evaluate_node(child)
                if isinstance(result, bool) and not result:
                    return "Sequence failed"
            return "Sequence succeeded"
        
        elif node["type"] == "selector":
            for child in node["children"]:
                result = self._evaluate_node(child)
                if isinstance(result, str) and result != "Sequence failed":
                    return result
            return "Selector failed"
        
        return "Unknown node type"
